nemdao.title: DAO（NEM）
nemdao.lead: ガバナンストークンで運営する組織（DAO）を作り、会員へのトークン配布と、会員による投票を行います。

nemdao.create_explain:
DAO専用の新しいアカウントを作り、次の順に進めます。
1. DAOアカウントへXEMを入金
2. ルートネームスペースの登録（{{rental}}）
3. ガバナンストークン（{{supply}}）の作成
4. トークンの全量を、あなた（管理者）へ渡す
5. DAOをマルチシグにし、あなたを連署者にする

それぞれ確定を待つので、全部で数分かかります。途中で止まっても、同じ名前で作成をやり直すと続きから進みます。

nemdao.items_explain:
ポイントと特典は、DAOのネームスペース「{{namespace}}」の子ネームスペースの中に作るモザイクです。
例: 子ネームスペース {{namespace}}.coffee の中に、特典のモザイク {{namespace}}.coffee:reward（ポイントなら :point）ができます。
作るのはDAOのアカウントで、管理者がDAOの名前で（マルチシグで）送ります。転送不可にするので、会員どうしでは動かせず、会員がポイントをDAOのアカウントへ戻すことだけができます。
どのDAOのものかと交換の条件は、モザイクの説明に書かれます。NEMにはポイントを強制的に回収する仕組みがないため、渡したポイントは会員のものです。

nemdao.bot_title: 自動引き渡しボット（サーバー専用）
nemdao.bot_lead: 会員の交換申請に、管理者の代わりに自動で特典を渡す仕組みです（NEMの交換は「会員がポイントを送る → 管理者が特典を渡す」の2段階なので、ボットは「渡す」側を行います）。このウォレットをサーバーで動かしているときだけ使えます。この画面からは起動できません。サーバーでコマンドを実行して動かします。使わないときは、これまでどおり管理者が手動で渡します。
nemdao.bot_step_1: 1. サーバーで、ボット専用のアカウントの鍵を作ります（ほかの用途と共用しません）。送信の手数料として、少量のXEM（1回あたり約0.15 XEM）を入れてください。
nemdao.bot_step_2: 2. そのアドレスを、このDAOの管理者（連署者）に追加します。下のボタンから行えます。追加する人（ボット）の同意の署名が要ります。
nemdao.bot_step_3: 3. サーバーで、次の設定を入れて起動します。最初は、判定だけして何も送らない試運転（KASANE_NEM_DAO_BOT_DRY_RUN=1）で確かめてください。本番にするときは、その行を外します。
nemdao.bot_add_admin: ボットを管理者に追加する
nemdao.bot_warn: ボットは管理者（連署者）の1人になります。ボットの鍵が漏れると、承認数しだいでDAOを操作されます。専用の鍵を使い、鍵ファイルの権限を絞ってください。ボットが送るのは特典の引き渡しだけです（設定変更・配布・ネームスペースなどには触れません）。承認数が2以上のときは、ボットが送った取引に、ほかの管理者の連署が要ります。
nemdao.bot_note: 渡すのは、払われたポイントが「個数×1個あたり」とぴったりで、24時間以内（変えられます）の、在庫のある申請だけです。それ以外は管理者が手動で渡します。ボットが動いているかどうかは、この画面では分かりません。

dao.bot_title: 自動連署ボット（サーバー専用）
dao.bot_lead: ポイント交換の申請に、管理者の代わりに自動で連署する仕組みです。このウォレットをサーバーで動かしているときだけ使えます。この画面からは起動できません。サーバーでコマンドを実行して動かします。使わないときは、これまでどおり管理者が手動で連署します。
dao.bot_step_1: 1. サーバーで、ボット専用のアカウントの鍵を作ります（ほかの用途と共用しません。XYMは入れなくて構いません）。
dao.bot_step_2: 2. そのアドレスを、このDAOの管理者（連署者）に追加します。下のボタンから行えます。追加する人（ボット）の同意の署名が要ります。
dao.bot_step_3: 3. サーバーで、次の設定を入れて起動します。最初は、判定だけして連署は送らない試運転（KASANE_DAO_BOT_DRY_RUN=1）で確かめてください。本番にするときは、その行を外します。

embedded.title: 内蔵ブラウザで開かれています
embedded.lead: このウォレットは、AIコーディングツール（Codex、Claude Desktop、VS Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot など）の内蔵ブラウザや、AIが操作するブラウザでは使わないでください。
reasons: 内蔵ブラウザは、AIが操作する前提で機能が足されているぶん、ふだんのブラウザより守りが弱いことがあります。ページからローカルのファイルを読み取れてしまう問題が報告されています（2026年10月）。
画面に出るニーモニックや、入力するパスワードを、AIが読み取るおそれがあります。
AIが出したリンクや、プロジェクトの中のHTMLを同じ内蔵ブラウザで開くと、このウォレットの保存データに手が届くことがあります。
embedded.file_note: このウォレットはファイル（file://）として開かれています。ブラウザによっては、同じブラウザで開いた他のローカルHTMLと保存領域を共有します。信頼できないHTMLは、そのブラウザで開かないでください。

embedded.address_body: Chrome・Edge・Safari などを自分で開き、次のアドレスを貼り付けてください。

apostille.type_signed_hint: ハッシュに自分の署名をつけて記録します。あなたが公証したことまで証明できます。ファイル名から決まる専用アカウントに送り、あとから「更新」できます。

apostille.public_only_ledger: Ledger のアカウントでは、公開のアポスティーユだけ作れます。署名つき（非公開）は、ファイルのハッシュにあなたの鍵で署名して専用アカウントを決めるため、鍵がデバイスの外に出ない Ledger では作れません。

harvest.start_confirm_title: ハーベストを開始しますか？

offline_cosign.intro: トランザクション本体を含む連署の依頼（開始した人の「連署QRを表示」）を、QR・画像・JSONファイル・貼り付けのいずれかで読み込みます。連署したあとのQRまたはJSONは、ネットに接続した端末の「読み込んで送信」タブで送信します。
offline_cosign.not_request: 連署の依頼ではありません。連署の依頼のQRまたはJSONを読み込んでください。
offline_cosign.hash_only: このQRはハッシュだけで、トランザクションの内容を含んでいません。内容を確認できないので、オフラインでは連署しません。開始した人に、内容を含むJSONファイルを出力してもらってください。
offline_cosign.unknown_mosaic_note: ネットワーク通貨以外のモザイクは、この端末が覚えているものだけ名前と桁数を表示します。覚えていないモザイクは、IDと最小単位の数量（小数点なし）で表示します。
offline_cosign.clock_warning: 有効期限の判定は、この端末の時計で行います。時計がずれていると、正しく判定できません。連署の前に、日付と時刻を確認してください。
offline_cosign.cosigner_hint: オフラインでは、このアカウントが実際に連署者かどうかは確認できません。連署者でなければ、連署しても無視されます。
offline_cosign.done_note: 連署しました。まだ送信されていません。QRコードまたはJSONを、ネットに接続した端末へ持ち出して、「読み込んで送信」タブで送信してください。
offline_cosign.qr_hint: ネットに接続した端末の「読み込んで送信」タブで、読み取りか貼り付けをして送信します。
offline_cosign.nem_intro: 開始した人が署名したマルチシグのトランザクション（内容を含む署名済みのデータ）を、QR・画像・JSONファイル・貼り付けのいずれかで読み込みます。連署したあとのQRまたはJSONは、ネットに接続した端末の「読み込んで送信」タブで送信します。
offline_cosign.nem_not_request: マルチシグのトランザクションではありません。連署するには、連署者がマルチシグアカウントの名義で署名したトランザクション（署名済みのデータ）が必要です。
offline_cosign.nem_cosign_note: 連署すると、このトランザクションに同意したことになります。内容をよく確認してください。表示している内容は、署名済みのデータそのものから読み取っています。
offline_cosign.nem_other_note: この種類のトランザクションは、内容の詳細をこの画面では表示できません。種類・マルチシグアカウント・開始した人・有効期限だけを確認して連署することになります。心当たりのないものには連署しないでください。
offline_cosign.nem_done_note: 連署しました。まだ送信されていません。NEMでは、開始した人のトランザクションがネットワークに届いたあとでないと、連署は受け付けられません。先に開始した人のトランザクションを「読み込んで送信」で送り、そのあとにこの連署を送ってください。
offline_cosign.nem_label_multisig: マルチシグアカウント
offline_cosign.nem_label_inner_hash: 連署が指すハッシュ（中身のトランザクション）
offline_cosign.nem_ms_self: 自分のアカウントから送る
offline_cosign.nem_ms_multisig: マルチシグアカウントの名義で送る
offline_cosign.nem_ms_sender: 開始する連署者（署名するアカウント）
offline_cosign.nem_ms_key: マルチシグアカウントの公開鍵
offline_cosign.nem_ms_key_hint: オフラインでは、アドレスから公開鍵を調べられません。公開鍵（64桁の16進）を入力してください。このアカウントが本当にマルチシグか、選んだアカウントが連署者かは、ここでは確認できません。
offline_cosign.nem_ms_key_invalid: 公開鍵は64桁の16進で入力してください
offline_cosign.nem_ms_key_self: 開始する連署者自身の公開鍵は指定できません
offline_cosign.nem_ms_note: マルチシグアカウントの名義で、ほかの連署者への連署の依頼を作ります。署名するのは開始する連署者だけで、中身の送金はまだ誰も署名していません。必要な数の連署が集まると実行されます。
offline_cosign.nem_ms_inner_fee: マルチシグアカウントが払う手数料
offline_cosign.nem_ms_wrapper_fee: 開始する連署者が払う手数料
offline_cosign.nem_ms_validity_fixed: 有効期限は署名から2時間です（マルチシグ経由では変更できません）。
offline_cosign.nem_ms_done_note: 連署の依頼を作りました。まだ送信されていません。先にこのQRまたはJSONを、ネットに接続した端末の「読み込んで送信」で送ってください。そのあとで、ほかの連署者が「トランザクションに連署」で連署し、その連署も「読み込んで送信」で送ります。
offline_cosign.sym_ms_note: マルチシグアカウントの名義で、ほかの連署者への連署の依頼を作ります。署名するのは開始する連署者だけで、中身の送金はまだ誰も署名していません。必要な数の連署が集まると実行されます。開始する連署者は、ハッシュロックとして10 XYMを預ける必要があります（実行されると戻ります）。
offline_cosign.sym_ms_agg_fee: 連署の依頼の手数料（上限）
offline_cosign.sym_ms_lock_fee: ハッシュロックの手数料
offline_cosign.sym_ms_lock_deposit: ハッシュロックの預け入れ（実行されると戻ります）
offline_cosign.sym_ms_lock_hash: ハッシュロックのハッシュ
offline_cosign.sym_ms_validity_note: ハッシュロックは、上で選んだ時間のうちに送ってください。連署の依頼は、署名から40時間のあいだ連署を集められます。
offline_cosign.sym_ms_done_note: 連署の依頼（ハッシュロックと連署待ちの送金）を作りました。まだ送信されていません。このQRまたはJSONを、ネットに接続した端末の「読み込んで送信」で送ってください。ハッシュロックが承認されたあとで、連署の依頼が送られます。そのあとで、ほかの連署者が「トランザクションに連署」で連署し、その連署も「読み込んで送信」で送ります。

offline_tx.wrong_chain: このQRは {{qr}} のものです。上で「{{qr}} …」を選び直してください（いま選んでいるのは {{selected}} です）。
offline_tx.import_lead: オフラインで作ったトランザクション（QRコード・JSON・ファイル）を読み込んで、ネットワークに発行します。読み込んだだけでは送られません。内容を確認して「送信」を押したときだけ送ります。

offline_tx.reason_offline: この端末はオフラインのため、トランザクションは送信していません。署名は済んでいるので、下のQRコード（またはファイル・テキスト）をネットワークにつながった端末で読み込めば、そのまま発行できます。
offline_tx.reason_unreachable: ノードに接続できなかったため、トランザクションは送信していません。署名は済んでいるので、下のQRコード（またはファイル・テキスト）を、ネットワークにつながる端末で読み込めば、そのまま発行できます。

offline_tx.qr_note: このQRコードには、署名済みのトランザクションだけが入っています。秘密鍵は入っていません。この画面を閉じると、QRコードは消えます。

offline_tx.step3: このQRコード（またはファイル・テキスト）を読み込み、内容を確かめて「送信」を押します。

console.title: コンソール
console.intro: コードを1つずつ打ち込んで、このウォレットのアカウントで送金やモザイク作成などを実行できます。今のネットワーク: {{network}}
console.safety: 他人から渡されたコードや、ネットで拾ったコードは貼らないでください。自分で読んで意味が分かるコードだけ実行してください。コードは、署名の要求、復号した中身の受け取り、インターネットへの送信ができます。署名・暗号化・復号のたびに内容の確認とパスワード入力が入り、秘密鍵はコードには渡りませんが、確認画面で承認したものは、悪意のあるコードに使われます。
console.no_account: 鍵を持つアカウントがありません
console.account_unusable: ウォレットで選んでいるアカウント（{{active}}）は、鍵を持たない（閲覧用・Ledger・SSS など）ため、コンソールでは使えません。代わりに {{signer}} を wallet にしています。
console.lang_hint_js: JavaScript として、そのまま動かします。
console.lang_hint_ts: 型を取り除いてから動かします（型のチェックはしないので、型が合っていなくてもエラーになりません）。サンプルも、型を付けた書き方で入ります。
console.file_loaded: 「{{name}}」を読み込みました（{{lines}} 行・{{lang}}）。内容を確認して、「実行」を押してください。
console.file_lang_switched: ファイルに合わせて、実行する言語を {{lang}} にしました。
console.file_err_ext: 「{{name}}」は読み込めません。対応しているのは .js / .mjs / .cjs / .ts / .mts / .cts / .txt / .md / .markdown です。
console.file_err_too_big: 「{{name}}」は大きすぎます（{{size}} KB。上限は {{max}} KB です）。
console.file_err_binary: 「{{name}}」はテキストファイルではないようです（バイナリが含まれています）。
console.file_err_dts: 「{{name}}」は型定義ファイル（.d.ts）です。実行できるコードが入っていません。
console.file_err_jsx: 「{{name}}」は JSX / TSX です。コンソールは JSX に対応していません。.js / .ts の書き方にしてください。
console.file_warn_encoding: 「{{name}}」は UTF-8 ではない可能性があります（読めない文字が含まれています）。UTF-8 で保存し直してください。
console.save_empty: 保存するコードがありません。
console.hint_node: ヒント: Node.js 用の require / module / process は使えません。import 文（import { SymbolFacade } from 'symbol-sdk/symbol' など）か、ここで渡した変数（facade・alice・NODE など）を使ってください。
console.help_file_open: ファイルを開く … .js / .mjs / .cjs / .ts / .mts / .cts / .txt（UTF-8、512 KB まで）を入力欄に読み込みます。自動では動かさないので、内容を読んでから「実行」を押してください。拡張子に合わせて、実行する言語も切り替わります。
console.help_file_save: コードを保存 … 入力欄のコード（空のときは、直前に実行したコード）を、.js / .ts のファイルとしてダウンロードします。
console.help_file_error: エラー … 構文エラーは、行・桁と、その行の中身（^ で位置）が出力に出ます。実行時のエラーは、種類・メッセージ・行が出ます。ファイルを読み込んだときは、「ファイル名:行:桁」も付きます。
console.file_err_md_none: 「{{name}}」には、実行できるコードブロック（js / javascript / ts / typescript）がありません。
console.md_pick_title: 読み込むコードブロックを選ぶ
console.md_pick_body: 「{{name}}」に js / ts のコードブロックが {{count}} 個あります。読み込むものを選んでください（複数選ぶと、順につないで1つにします）。
console.md_pick_item: ブロック {{n}}（{{lang}}・{{line}} 行目から・{{lines}} 行）
console.help_file_md: Obsidian のノート（.md） … ```js や ```ts のコードブロックを取り出して読み込みます（~~~ の柵や、> の中・箇条書きの中のブロックも使えます）。1つならそのまま入り、複数あるときは選べます。エラーの行番号は、ノートの行に合わせて出ます。ノートの全文を入力欄に貼り付けても同じように取り出せます（確認が出ます。「そのまま貼る」も選べます）。
console.paste_title: ノートとして読み込みますか？
console.paste_body: 貼り付けた内容に、js / ts のコードブロックが {{count}} 個あります。Markdown のノートのようです。コードブロックだけを取り出して読み込みますか？（「そのまま貼る」を選ぶと、内容をそのまま入力欄に入れます）
console.paste_extract: コードブロックを取り出す
console.placeholder: ここにコードを入力。例: console.log(wallet.address.toString())
console.shortcut: Enter で実行、Shift + Enter で改行（括弧が閉じていないときは Enter で改行になります）。↑ ↓ で前の入力、Ctrl + L で出力を消します。入力は「<」、結果は「>」に出ます。変数は実行をまたいで残ります（リセットで消えます）。
console.output_empty: ここに入力と結果が並びます。下の「<」にコードを入力して Enter を押してください。
console.help_facade: facade … SymbolFacade（今のネットワーク）。SDK のクラス（PrivateKey, Address, models, generateMosaicId など）もそのまま使えます。
console.help_node: NODE … 今つながっているノードのURL。fetch(new URL('/node/info', NODE)) のように使います。
console.help_wallet: alice … ウォレットで使っているアカウント（wallet でも同じです）。alice.address / alice.publicKey / alice.signTransaction(tx) / alice.messageEncoder() が使えます（秘密鍵は渡さず、署名・暗号化・復号のたびに確認が入ります）。walletKeyPair / walletAddress も使えます。
console.help_clog: clog(tx) … アナウンスした tx のステータスやエクスプローラーの URL を表示します。
console.help_sdk: await import('…symbol-sdk…') と import { SymbolFacade } from 'symbol-sdk/symbol' のような import 文も使えます（同梱のSDKが返ります。外のコードは読み込みません）。
console.help_web: fetch / WebSocket / setTimeout が使えます。初期設定では、通信できるのは、インターネット上の相手と、いま使っているノードだけです（このPC・同じLAN・localhost への通信は止まり、転送先への自動の追従もしません）。開発者向けの詳細設定で、「通信を制限する」などを項目ごとにオフにできます。結果は console.log で出力します。最後の式の値は「>」の行に表示されます。
console.help_keep: 自分で作った鍵（facade.createAccount(sdkCore.PrivateKey.random()) など）は、確認なしで署名できます。テストネットの動作確認に便利です。alice / wallet とは別の名前（bob など）で作れば、ウォレットのアカウントもそのまま使えます。
console.help_limit_syntax: コンストラクタ（class の constructor）と、同期のジェネレータ（function*）の中では、署名の確認待ちはできません（async 関数・async function* を使ってください）。sort の比較関数のように、結果をその場で使うコールバックで待つと、値の代わりに Promise が返ります。
console.help_limit_ts: TypeScript … 切り替えは次に実行するコードから効きます。型注釈・interface・type・as・! ・ジェネリクス・enum・コンストラクタの引数のアクセス修飾子などを取り除いて動かすだけで、型のチェックはしません。値を持つ namespace は使えません（エラーになります）。
console.help_limit_sign: Ledger のアカウントは使えません。
console.help_limit_access: 画面（document）や保存データ（localStorage）、eval は使えません。コードから見えるのは、ここで渡したものだけです。
console.help_limit_size: 1回の操作で巨大な文字列・配列・BigInt を作るコードは、エラーで止まります。正規表現の総当たりのように「停止」に応じない重い処理は、「停止」を押して1〜2秒待つと強制的に止まります（そのときは、それまでに作った変数も消えます）。
console.worker_restarted: 停止できない処理だったため、実行環境を作り直しました（変数は消えました）。

console.sign_warning: コンソールで実行中のコードが、あなたのアカウントでの署名を求めています。内容に心当たりがなければ、キャンセルしてください。
console.sign_data_warning: トランザクションではない、任意のデータへの署名です。意味の分からないデータには署名しないでください。
console.sign_data_hash32_warning: 32バイトちょうどのデータです。トランザクションのハッシュへの署名（連署）と同じ形で、署名すると、他人のトランザクションに連署したことになるおそれがあります。心当たりがなければキャンセルしてください。
console.sign_via_raw_warning: コードは、これを「任意のデータへの署名」として求めましたが、中身はトランザクションです。下の内容（送金先・金額など）を確認してください。
console.sign_hash_only_warning: トランザクションのハッシュ（32バイト）への署名です。このハッシュが何のトランザクションのものかは、ここでは確かめられません。署名すると、そのトランザクションに連署したことになります。自分で用意したトランザクションの連署でなければ、キャンセルしてください。
console.net_limit_hint: オンのとき、コードの fetch / WebSocket は、このPC・同じLAN・localhost に送れません（いま使っているノードは除く）。ブラウザに保存され、実行中のコードにもすぐ効きます。
console.net_unlimited_notice: 通信の制限はオフです。コードは、このPCや同じLANのサービスにも通信できます。他人のコードは実行しないでください。
console.net_unlimited_title: 通信の制限をオフにしますか？
console.net_unlimited_body: オフにすると、コンソールのコードは、このPCのlocalhostや同じLAN内の機器（ルーター、NAS、開発中のサーバーなど）にも、あなたに見えないまま通信できます。自分で書いた、または読んで理解したコードだけを実行するときにだけ、オフにしてください。
console.prot_show: 開発者向けの詳細設定を開く
console.prot_hide: 開発者向けの詳細設定を閉じる
console.prot_intro: 次の4つは、初期設定ではすべてオン（保護する）です。開発中のサーバーなどで不便なときだけ、項目ごとにオフにできます。ブラウザに保存され、実行中のコードにもすぐ効きます。なお、http / https / ws / wss 以外の通信は、ブラウザの CSP でも止まるため、切り替えられません。
console.prot_off_notice: 通信の保護の一部がオフです。コードは、認証情報や参照元を付けて通信できます。他人のコードは実行しないでください。
console.prot_blockUrlCredentials_label: URL内のユーザー名・パスワードを禁止する
console.prot_blockUrlCredentials_hint: オフにすると、https://user:pass@host/ の形の URL を使えます（Basic認証つきの開発サーバーなど）。
console.prot_blockUrlCredentials_title: URL内のユーザー名・パスワードの禁止をオフにしますか？
console.prot_blockUrlCredentials_body: オフにすると、コードは https://ユーザー名:パスワード@ホスト/ の形の URL に通信できます。URL にパスワードを書くと、履歴やログ、通信先に残ることがあります。自分で書いた、または読んで理解したコードだけを実行するときにだけ、オフにしてください。
console.prot_omitCookies_hint: オフにすると、fetch の credentials の指定（なければブラウザの既定）に従い、Cookie などの認証情報を付けられます。WebSocket の Cookie は、ブラウザが決めます。
console.prot_omitCookies_title: Cookie を送らない設定をオフにしますか？
console.prot_omitCookies_body: オフにすると、コードの fetch は、通信先のサイトに保存されたあなたの Cookie を付けて送れます（ログイン済みのサービスとして操作できてしまいます）。自分で書いた、または読んで理解したコードだけを実行するときにだけ、オフにしてください。
console.prot_hideReferrer_hint: オフにすると、fetch の referrerPolicy の指定（なければブラウザの既定）に従い、このウォレットのURLが参照元として通信先に伝わることがあります。
console.prot_hideReferrer_title: 参照元を送らない設定をオフにしますか？
console.prot_hideReferrer_body: オフにすると、コードの通信で、このウォレットを開いているURLが通信先に伝わることがあります。自分で書いた、または読んで理解したコードだけを実行するときにだけ、オフにしてください。
console.sign_data_text: 署名するデータ（文字列）
console.sign_data_hex: 署名するデータ（{{bytes}} バイト、16進数）
console.sign_cosign_note: 連署（アグリゲートトランザクションへの承認）です。
console.sign_reading: 内容を読み取っています…
console.sign_unreadable: トランザクションの内容を読み取れませんでした。内容が分からないものには署名しないでください。
console.sign_wrong_network: 今のネットワークとは別のネットワークのトランザクションです。
console.sign_hash_mismatch: アグリゲートの中身と、署名されるハッシュが一致しません。署名しないでください。
console.crypt_warning_encrypt: コンソールで実行中のコードが、あなたのアカウントの鍵でメッセージを暗号化しようとしています。コードに返るのは暗号文だけで、秘密鍵は渡りません。内容に心当たりがなければ、キャンセルしてください。
console.crypt_warning_decrypt: コンソールで実行中のコードが、あなたのアカウントの鍵で暗号文を復号しようとしています。復号した中身はコードに渡り、コードはそれをインターネットへ送ることもできます（秘密鍵は渡りません）。心当たりがなければ、キャンセルしてください。
console.crypt_plain_text: 暗号化する内容（文字列）
console.crypt_plain_hex: 暗号化する内容（{{bytes}} バイト、16進数）
console.crypt_cipher_hex: 復号する暗号文（{{bytes}} バイト、16進数）

signmsg.create_title: 署名付きメッセージの作成
signmsg.verify_title: 署名付きメッセージの検証
signmsg.about: 文章にアカウントの鍵で署名します。署名と公開鍵があれば、だれでも「この文章に、この公開鍵の持ち主が署名した」ことを確かめられます。トランザクションではないので、ブロックチェーンには何も送らず、手数料もかかりません。
signmsg.warning: 意味のわからない文字列や、他人に言われるままの文章には署名しないでください。署名した文章は、あなたが書いたものとして扱われます。
signmsg.message_hint: 空白や改行も1文字ずつ署名の対象です。検証するときも、まったく同じ文章が必要です。
signmsg.message_too_long: メッセージが長すぎます（最大 {{max}} バイト）
signmsg.signed_note: 署名しました。メッセージ・署名・公開鍵を相手に渡すと、検証してもらえます。
signmsg.signer_address: 署名したアカウントのアドレス
signmsg.share_hint: メッセージ・署名・公開鍵をひとまとめにしたテキストです。相手は「署名を検証」の貼り付け欄に入れて読み込めます。
signmsg.share_nano_hint: NanoWalletの「署名付きメッセージを検証」にそのまま貼り付けられる形式です。メッセージは署名したバイト列の16進数になっています。
signmsg.verify_intro: 署名付きメッセージのテキストを貼り付けて「検証する」を押すと、メッセージ・公開鍵・署名が合っているかを確かめます。
signmsg.paste_label: 署名付きメッセージのテキストを貼り付け
signmsg.paste_hint: KASANEで作ったテキスト、またはNanoWalletの署名付きメッセージ（{"message", "signer", "signature"}）。{"message", "publicKey", "signature"} だけのJSONも可
signmsg.paste_invalid: 読み込めません。メッセージ・公開鍵（64桁）・署名（128桁）がそろっているか確認してください。
signmsg.public_key_invalid: 公開鍵は16進数の64桁です
signmsg.address_hint: 入れると、公開鍵がこのアドレスのものかも確かめます。
signmsg.valid_note: この公開鍵の持ち主（アドレス: {{address}}）が、このメッセージに署名しています。
signmsg.valid_nano_encoding: 絵文字などの文字は、NanoWalletの符号化で署名されたものとして一致しました。
signmsg.invalid_title: 署名が正しくありません
signmsg.invalid_note: メッセージ・公開鍵・署名のどれかが違うか、書き換えられています。空白や改行が1つ違うだけでも合いません。
signmsg.mismatch_title: 署名は正しいですが、アドレスが違います
signmsg.mismatch_note: この公開鍵のアドレスは {{address}} です。入力したアドレスとは別のアカウントが署名しています。
signmsg.signed_empty: メッセージに署名すると、ここに署名付きメッセージが出ます。
signmsg.result_empty: 検証すると、ここに結果が出ます。
signmsg.manual_toggle: メッセージ・公開鍵・署名を別々に入力する
signmsg.symbol_signer_none: 署名できるSymbolのアカウントがありません（Ledgerと閲覧用は署名できません）
signmsg.paste_hint_symbol: KASANEで作ったテキスト。{"message", "publicKey", "signature"} だけのJSONも可
signmsg.paste_is_nem: これはNEMの署名付きメッセージです。NEMとSymbolでは署名方式が違うので、ここでは検証できません。左上のメニューでNEMに切り替えて検証してください。

nemdns.title: DNS
nemdns.about: ネームスペースに、サイトのアドレスや連絡先を紐づけます。「kasane.nem」のような名前から、持ち主が登録した情報を調べられます。

nemdns.search_hint: 「.nem」は付けても付けなくても構いません。

nemdns.err_namespace_not_found: このネームスペースは見つかりません。
nemdns.err_lookup_failed: 調べられませんでした。ネットワークの状態を確認して、もう一度お試しください。
nemdns.expired_note: このネームスペースは有効期限が切れています。持ち主が変わっている可能性があり、表示されている情報は古いかもしれません。
nemdns.owner: ネームスペースの持ち主
nemdns.no_record: このネームスペースには、DNSの情報が登録されていません。
nemdns.record_found: 持ち主が登録した情報が見つかりました。
nemdns.record_empty: 登録されている項目はありません。
nemdns.record_tx: 登録トランザクション

nemdns.site_not_openable: サイトのアドレスの形が正しくないため、開けません。
nemdns.configure_about: 自分のネームスペースに、サイトのアドレスや連絡先を登録・更新します。ポインタアカウントへ、内容を書いた0 XEMの送金をするだけで、ネームスペースの持ち主が送ったものだけが検索に表示されます。
nemdns.public_warning: 登録した内容はブロックチェーンに記録され、だれでも読めます。個人情報（自宅の住所・電話番号など）は入れないでください。更新すると新しい内容が表示されますが、古い内容も記録として残ります。
nemdns.owner_account_hint: マルチシグのネームスペースは、そのアカウント名義で登録します（連署が必要です）。
nemdns.no_namespace: 登録できるネームスペースがありません。（有効期限が切れたものは除きます）
nemdns.select_namespace: ネームスペースを選択
nemdns.result_empty: ネームスペース名を入れて検索すると、登録内容がここに出ます。
nemdns.configure_empty: 左でネームスペースを選ぶと、登録内容の入力欄がここに出ます。
nemdns.pointer_hint: このネームスペースの「住所」です。鍵はだれでも計算できるので、ここにXEMなどの資産を送らないでください。
nemdns.loading_current: 現在の登録内容を読み込んでいます...

nemdns.too_long: 長すぎます（最大{{max}}バイト）。短くしてください。

nemdns.sent_multisig: マルチシグ名義の送信です。必要な数の連署が集まると、記録されます。

nemdns.no_wallet: アカウントが見つかりません。

symbolvoting.type_mosaic_short: モザイク保有量で重み付け
symbolvoting.type_mosaic_hint: 誰でも投票でき、指定したモザイクの保有量で重み付けして集計します。計算式は「重要度で重み付け」と同じです。
symbolvoting.counting_mosaic: 票は、投票が終わった時点で各アカウントが持つ指定モザイクの量で重み付けして集計されます。投票期間中に手放して量が減った場合は、減った後の量で数えます。終了時点でモザイクを持っていないアカウントの票は無効です。承認済みの票のみが対象です。
symbolvoting.approximate_mosaic_note: 終了時点の保有量は、送金履歴からの概算です（収穫の報酬など、送金に現れない増減は反映されません）。
symbolvoting.mosaic_label: 重み付けに使うモザイク
symbolvoting.mosaic_placeholder: モザイクID（16桁）またはネームスペース名
symbolvoting.mosaic_hint: 例: 6BED913FA20223F8、symbol.xym。ネームスペースがモザイクに紐付いていれば、その名前でも指定できます。
symbolvoting.mosaic_err_invalid: モザイクIDは16桁の16進数で、またはネームスペース名で入力してください。
symbolvoting.mosaic_err_not_found: このモザイクはチェーン上に見つかりません。
symbolvoting.mosaic_err_namespace: このネームスペースが見つかりません。
symbolvoting.mosaic_err_alias: このネームスペースはモザイクに紐付いていません。
symbolvoting.mosaic_err_failed: 確認できませんでした。接続を確認して、もう一度お試しください。
symbolvoting.mosaic_zero_warning: このアカウントは指定のモザイクを持っていません。投票終了時点でも持っていない場合、票は無効になります。
symbolvoting.simple_note: 簡易投票では、1人が複数のアカウントで投票することを防げません（アカウントは誰でも何個でも作れます）。厳密に数えたいときはホワイトリストを使ってください。
symbolvoting.list_hint: 公開の索引に載っている投票です。この索引は、KASANE の Symbol 版の投票だけが載る専用のアドレスです。
symbolvoting.create_intro: 投票はブロックチェーンに書き込まれ、索引に載ります。作成後に内容は変更できません。1 回の送信（アグリゲート）にまとめて送るので、途中までの投票ができることはありません。
symbolvoting.xym_short_warning: XYMが足りません。手数料の分のXYMが必要です。
symbolvoting.cost_hint: 投票は、0 XYM の送金メッセージをまとめた 1 つのアグリゲートとして書き込まれ、その手数料のみかかります。
symbolvoting.messages_label: 書き込むメッセージ数
error_insufficient_balance_message: 手数料の合計が、XYMの残高を超えています。
XYMを追加してから、もう一度お試しください。
symbolvoting.provisional_note: 投票期間中の暫定結果です。結果は、投票終了時点のモザイク保有量で確定します。
symbolvoting.excluded_note: 終了時点でモザイクを持っていないため、無効になった票: {{count}}件
symbolvoting.my_vote_invalid: あなたの票は、モザイクを持っていないため無効です（重み付けの対象外）。
symbolvoting.type_holder_short: モザイク保有者による投票
symbolvoting.type_holder_hint: 指定したモザイクを持っているアカウントだけが投票できます。持っている量は関係なく、1アカウント1票で集計します。
symbolvoting.counting_holder: 票は、投票が終わった時点で指定のモザイクを持っているアカウントのものだけを、1アカウント1票で集計します（持っている量は票の重みになりません）。投票期間中に手放して持っていなくなった場合、その票は無効です。承認済みの票のみが対象です。
symbolvoting.holder_rule_label: 対象にできるモザイク
symbolvoting.holder_rule_nt: 移転できないモザイクのみ（推奨）
symbolvoting.holder_rule_nt_desc: 第三者に移せない設定のモザイクだけを指定できます。モザイクを渡せるのは作成者だけなので、持っている人が勝手に増えることはありません。
symbolvoting.holder_rule_any: 移転できるモザイクでもよい
symbolvoting.holder_rule_any_desc: 誰にでも渡せるモザイクも指定できます。すでに広く行き渡っているモザイクを対象にしたいときに使います。
symbolvoting.holder_rule_any_warning: 移転できるモザイクは、量が少なくても投票できるため、モザイクを細かく分けて別のアカウントへ送るだけで、票を増やせてしまいます。票の重複を防ぎたいときは「移転できないモザイクのみ」を選んでください。
symbolvoting.holder_nt_required_error: 「移転できないモザイクのみ」では、移転できる設定のモザイクは指定できません。移転できないモザイクを指定するか、条件を「移転できるモザイクでもよい」に変えてください。
symbolvoting.holder_badge_nt: 移転不可のモザイクのみ
symbolvoting.holder_badge_any: 移転可のモザイクも対象
symbolvoting.holder_rule_broken_note: この投票は「移転できないモザイクのみ」と定められていますが、指定のモザイクは移転できる設定になっています。条件を満たさないため、票は1つも数えていません。
symbolvoting.holder_my_vote_invalid: あなたの票は、投票終了時点でモザイクを持っていないため無効です。

nemdao.title: DAO (NEM)
nemdao.lead: Create an organization (DAO) run with a governance token: hand tokens to members and let them vote.
nemdao.no_wallet: Could not load the NEM account.
nemdao.hint_dao_id: The public key of the DAO account (64 hex characters).
nemdao.managed_none: You do not manage any DAO.
nemdao.hint_name: It is written in the description of the governance token, so anyone can read it.
nemdao.hint_namespace: Lower-case letters, digits, _ and -, up to {{max}} characters. A NEM root namespace is a name that exists only once.
nemdao.create_explain:
A new account just for the DAO is created, and these steps follow in order:
1. Deposit XEM into the DAO account
2. Register the root namespace ({{rental}})
3. Create the governance token ({{supply}})
4. Hand the whole supply to you (the administrator)
5. Make the DAO a multisig account with you as the cosigner

Each step waits for confirmation, so the whole thing takes a few minutes. If it stops half-way, create it again with the same names and it continues from where it stopped.
nemdao.err_namespace_invalid: This name cannot be used as a namespace.
nemdao.err_namespace_taken: This namespace is already used by someone else. Choose another name.
nemdao.err_confirm_timeout: The transaction is taking too long to confirm.
nemdao.err_stuck: The same step did not move forward. The node may not be accepting the transaction.
nemdao.err_not_dao: No DAO was found for this ID. It may have been dissolved because its namespace expired.
nemdao.row_governance_value: {{id}} (supply {{amount}}, the whole supply goes to the administrator)
nemdao.row_deposit_note: It covers the namespace and mosaic rental fees and the transaction fees. What is left stays in the DAO account for later fees.
nemdao.row_time_value: A few minutes (each step waits for confirmation)
nemdao.running_note: Do not close this screen. If you do, create the DAO again with the same names and it continues from where it stopped.
nemdao.step_handover: Hand the tokens to the administrator
nemdao.resume_note: Create it again with the same name and namespace and it continues from where it stopped.
nemdao.no_admins: There is no cosigner (the DAO is not multisig yet).
nemdao.go_multisig_hint: Adding or removing administrators and changing the required approvals are done right here. A change takes effect once the other admins have co-signed. Co-signing for things like sending from the DAO account is done on the Multisig screen.
nemdao.ns_soon: The DAO namespace "{{namespace}}" expires in about {{days}} days. Once it expires the DAO is treated as dissolved: token distribution, voting and point exchange stop working.
nemdao.ns_expired: The DAO namespace "{{namespace}}" has expired. An administrator can restore the DAO by renewing it on the "Namespace" tab within the grace period.
nemdao.ns_lost: The namespace "{{namespace}}" no longer belongs to this DAO's account (it may have been taken by someone else after the grace period). It cannot be restored; create a new DAO with a new name if needed.
nemdao.ns_unknown: Could not check the expiry of the DAO namespace "{{namespace}}". Please reopen the screen later.
nemdao.ns_ok: About {{days}} days left. It can be renewed once it is within 30 days of expiry.
nemdao.ns_renew_howto: Renews the DAO namespace (sent in the DAO account's name with the administrator's cosignature). It costs 100 XEM plus the fee and extends it by one year.
nemdao.access_lead: Choose who can open the DAO pages (members, governance votes, reward exchange, and so on). Admins can always enter.
nemdao.access_id: DAO ID only (anyone who has the ID can enter)
nemdao.access_token: DAO ID and governance token (only people holding at least one governance token can enter)
nemdao.access_note: NEM has no metadata, so this is written into the governance token's description (the token definition is re-sent with the same content; the DAO account pays the registration fee and the transaction fee). This setting decides who gets in through this wallet; the blockchain data itself is readable by anyone.
nemdao.access_row_value: Change who can enter the DAO
nemdao.access_row_fee: Paid by the DAO account (about {{cost}}: registration fee and transaction fee)
nemdao.access_row_deposit_value: The DAO account does not have enough XEM, so {{amount}} is sent from the admin account first.
done_access: It takes effect once it is in a block. With several admins, after all of them have co-signed.
nemdao.gate_lead: This DAO is open only to people who hold the governance token, in addition to knowing the DAO ID. You can enter once you receive the governance token.
nemdao.gate_unreadable: Could not read your governance token balance. Please reload.
nemdao.dissolved_title: This DAO is treated as dissolved
nemdao.members_note: Shows the accounts the administrators (and the DAO) sent this token to, largest holding first. Tokens that went on from someone other than an administrator do not appear.
nemdao.distribute_lead: Sends {{id}} to members from your (administrator's) account, out of what you hold.
nemdao.hint_recipients: Separate them with line breaks, spaces or commas.
nemdao.admin_only_distribute: Only an administrator can hand out tokens.
nemdao.row_fee_value: Each transfer costs a fee in XEM
done_distribute: The member list updates once the blocks include them.
nemdao.gov_lead: Creates a poll that holders of {{id}} can vote in.
nemdao.gov_no_tokens: You do not hold this token, so you cannot take part in a vote.
nemdao.gov_none: No poll of this DAO was found yet.
nemdao.gov_load_failed: Could not load the poll list.
nemdao.gov_note: Only polls that use this governance token are picked out of the public poll index of NEM. A new poll appears once its blocks are confirmed.
nemdao.vote_members_only: Only people who hold the governance token can vote.
nemdao.vote_weight_hint: Weighted: each vote counts as many times as governance tokens held. Unweighted: one vote per holder, whatever they hold.
nemdao.vote_create_note: The vote is written in the same format as the official NEM Wallet. Whoever holds this governance token when the vote ends can vote. Creating it sends several 0 XEM messages (only fees are charged).
nemdao.row_item_fee_value: A 10 XEM sub-namespace rental fee, a 10 XEM mosaic rental fee and transaction fees. The DAO account pays them, so the missing part ({{topup}}) is deposited from your account into the DAO account.
done_exchange: An administrator will check and hand over the reward. It is not handed over automatically.
nemdao.items_explain:
Points and rewards are mosaics created inside a sub-namespace of the DAO namespace "{{namespace}}".
Example: inside the sub-namespace {{namespace}}.coffee, the reward mosaic is {{namespace}}.coffee:reward (for a point, :point).
The DAO account creates them; an administrator sends the transactions in the DAO's name (through multisig). They are non-transferable, so members cannot move them between themselves; they can only send points back to the DAO account.
The DAO a mosaic belongs to, and the exchange terms, are written in its description. NEM has no way to take points back by force, so points that were handed out belong to the member.
nemdao.hint_item_amount: The DAO account holds all of it at first. What you hand out is sent from there.
nemdao.hint_point: Choose one of this DAO's points.
done_supply: It takes effect once the block includes it.
nemdao.supply_now: Supply now: {{supply}} / Held by the DAO account: {{held}}
nemdao.hint_supply_increase: What is added goes to the DAO account.
nemdao.hint_supply_decrease: You can lower it by up to what the DAO account holds.
nemdao.err_supply_not_held: You cannot lower it by more than the DAO account holds.
nemdao.err_supply_supply_too_large: The supply would exceed the limit (9 billion).
nemdao.distribute_lead_dao: Sends {{id}} to members from the DAO account (you send it in the DAO's name), out of what the DAO account holds.
nemdao.row_fee_value_dao: Each transfer costs a fee in XEM (the DAO account pays it)
nemdao.row_cosign_value: The DAO has several cosigners, so a transaction in its name is not confirmed until the other administrators cosign it (Multisig screen).
nemdao.err_dao_xem:
The DAO account does not have enough XEM (it pays the fees). Send XEM to the DAO address so that it holds at least {{need}}.
{{address}}
nemdao.item_running_note: Do not close this screen. If you do, create it again with the same input and it continues from where it stopped. With several cosigners, it waits for the other administrators to cosign.
nemdao.item_created_note: {{id}} was created. It shows up in the list.
nemdao.item_resume_note: Create it again with the same input and it continues from where it stopped.
nemdao.hint_item_part: Created under the DAO namespace "{{namespace}}". Lower-case letters, digits, _ and -, up to 64 characters.
nemdao.err_item_too_long: The description is too long. Shorten the name or the description.
nemdao.items_supply_hint: Use "Change supply" to raise or lower the supply. What is added goes to the DAO account, and you can only lower it by what the DAO account holds (points already handed out cannot be taken back).
nemdao.row_exchange_note_value: Sending the points files a request with the DAO. An administrator checks it and hands over the reward; it does not arrive automatically.
nemdao.rewards_none: There is no reward to exchange for yet.
nemdao.exchange_two_step: Sending points to the DAO account files a request. An administrator checks it and hands over the reward, so it does not arrive at once.
nemdao.requests_note: Requests that reached the DAO account are searched, newest first, up to about 150. A request whose points fall short cannot be fulfilled. Points paid in excess stay in the DAO account. You send the reward in the DAO's name (with several cosigners, the other administrators' cosignatures confirm it).
nemdao.limited_lead: Only people holding a reward of this DAO can open this page. As a sample, pick a theme colour and save it to your own account.
nemdao.limited_locked: Only people holding a reward of this DAO (and admins) can open this page.
nemdao.limited_fee: Paid by your own account (about 0.05 XEM)
nemdao.limited_note: NEM has no metadata, so the chosen theme is written in the message of a 0 XEM transfer to yourself (the newest one is read). It does not change the look of the whole wallet.
done_limited: It shows as saved once it is in a block.
nemdao.bot_lead: A bot can hand over rewards automatically for exchange requests, in place of an admin (a NEM exchange has two steps: the member sends points, then an admin hands over the reward, so the bot does the second step). It works only when this wallet is run on a server, and it cannot be started from this screen: you run a command on the server. Without it, admins hand rewards over by hand as before.
nemdao.bot_step_1: 1. On the server, create a key for a bot-only account (do not share it with anything else). Put in a little XEM for sending fees (about 0.15 XEM each).
nemdao.bot_step_2: 2. Add its address as an admin (cosigner) of this DAO with the button below. The new cosigner (the bot) must also sign to agree.
nemdao.bot_step_3: 3. On the server, set the following and start it. First try a dry run (KASANE_NEM_DAO_BOT_DRY_RUN=1), which only checks and sends nothing. Remove that line to go live.
nemdao.bot_add_admin: Add the bot as an admin
nemdao.bot_warn: The bot becomes one of the admins (cosigners). If its key leaks, the DAO can be operated depending on the approval count. Use a dedicated key and restrict the key file permissions. The bot only hands over rewards (never settings, distribution, namespaces, and so on). With an approval count of 2 or more, the other admins must also cosign what the bot sends.
nemdao.bot_note: It hands over only requests where the points paid match "quantity x cost" exactly, made within 24 hours (adjustable), and in stock. Everything else is left to an admin. This screen cannot tell whether the bot is running.

dao.title: DAO
dao.lead: Create an organization (DAO) run with a governance token, and use points, rewards, exchange and voting.
dao.hint_dao_id: The DAO account's public key (64 characters)
dao.managed_none: This account is not an admin of any DAO.
dao.create_explain: This creates a new account (the DAO), funds it, issues the governance token ({{supply}}) and turns the account into a multisig with only you as the admin. The DAO's key is used inside this creation and then discarded; from then on, acting as the DAO needs the admins' signatures.
dao.row_governance_value: {{amount}} issued (held by the DAO, handed out to members)
dao.access_lead: Choose who can open the DAO pages (governance votes, point exchange, members-only, and so on). Admins can always enter.
dao.access_id: DAO ID only (anyone who has the ID can enter)
dao.access_token: DAO ID and governance token (only people holding at least one governance token can enter)
dao.access_note: This is written to the DAO account's own metadata (key 7). It decides who gets in through this wallet; the blockchain data itself is readable by anyone.
dao.access_row_value: Change who can enter the DAO
dao.gate_lead: This DAO is open only to people who hold the governance token, in addition to knowing the DAO ID. You can enter once you receive the governance token.
dao.err_not_dao: This account exists but has no DAO data (governance token, etc.). Check the DAO ID, and that the DAO creation has been confirmed.
dao.err_not_found: No account with this ID exists on this network ({{network}}). Check the selected network (mainnet / testnet), and that the ID is a public key, not an address.
dao.err_invalid_signer: Could not read the DAO account's signing setup.
dao.err_no_holders: No account holds the governance token, so nobody can vote.
dao.err_too_many_items: More than one operation can handle (1000 items).
dao.err_stock: The total to hand out is more than the DAO holds.
dao.err_revoke_over: Some members hold less than the amount to take back.
dao.err_exchange_stock: The quantity is more than what is left.
dao.cost_lock_note: Returned once the other admins have signed and it completes.
dao.cost_cosign_value: {{count}} signature(s) from other accounts are needed. They can sign from the pending list under Multisig.
done_bonded: Waiting for the other admins' signatures. It completes once they have signed.
dao.home_holdings_none: You hold no tokens, points or rewards of this DAO.
dao.settings_note: Adding or removing admins and changing the required approvals are done from the button below, right here. The person being added has to sign to agree, and so do the other admins.
dao.bot_lead: A bot can cosign point-exchange requests automatically, in place of an admin. It works only when this wallet is run on a server, and it cannot be started from this screen: you run a command on the server. Without it, admins cosign by hand as before.
dao.bot_step_1: 1. On the server, create a key for a bot-only account (do not share it with anything else; it needs no XYM).
dao.bot_step_2: 2. Add its address as an admin (cosigner) of this DAO with the button below. The new cosigner (the bot) must also sign to agree.
dao.bot_step_3: 3. On the server, set the following and start it. First try a dry run (KASANE_DAO_BOT_DRY_RUN=1), which only checks and sends no cosignature. Remove that line to go live.
dao.bot_add_admin: Add the bot as an admin
dao.bot_warn: The bot becomes one of the admins (cosigners). If its key leaks, the DAO can be operated depending on the approval count. Use a dedicated key and restrict the key file permissions. The bot cosigns only exchange requests (never settings, distribution, revocation, and so on).
dao.bot_note: This screen cannot tell whether the bot is running.
dao.point_lead: Points issued by the DAO. Hand them out to members and take them back later.
dao.point_create_note: Points cannot be transferred and only the DAO can take them back. The DAO account pays the creation cost, so funds are added with it if needed.
dao.reward_lead: Rewards issued by the DAO. Hand them out, or make them exchange items for points.
dao.reward_create_note: Rewards can be neither transferred nor taken back. The DAO account pays the creation cost, so funds are added with it if needed.
dao.hint_supply: A whole number. It cannot be changed later.
dao.exchange_request_note: An exchange is a request. Once an admin signs (in a DAO that uses the auto-cosign bot, the bot signs automatically), the points are taken and the reward is sent. While it waits, 10 XYM is held as a hash lock in addition to the fee.
dao.exchange_set_need: Create a reward and points first.
dao.vote_deadline_hint: Entered in this device's time. Leave empty for no deadline. After it passes, voting is closed in the app.
dao.vote_deadline_past: Choose a date and time in the future.
dao.vote_closed_note: This vote expired on {{date}}. It can no longer be voted on in the app, and anything sent to the boxes after that is left out of the tally (once its creator closes it, voting stops on the chain too).
dao.vote_sealed_note: This vote has been closed (the remaining vote tokens were taken back). No more votes can be cast. The tally is the final result.
dao.vote_late_excluded: {{amount}} vote(s) sent to the boxes after the deadline are left out of the tally.
dao.vote_late_unknown: Could not check transfers made after the deadline. The tally may include votes sent after it.
dao.vote_close_note: Takes back the remaining vote tokens from everyone who holds them (the boxes excluded) and makes them unusable. Votes already in the boxes stay, and nobody can vote afterwards. Only the account that created this vote can do it. It cannot be undone. You can close before the deadline too. With many holders, it is signed in groups of 100.
dao.vote_close_targets_value: {{count}} person/people ({{amount}} vote tokens taken back in total)
dao.vote_close_burn_note: A throwaway address nobody can sign for (so the creator cannot use them).
dao.err_invalid_deadline: The deadline must be in the future.
dao.err_too_many_options: A vote can have up to 6 options.
dao.vote_voters_value: {{count}} member(s) ({{supply}} vote tokens handed out in total)
dao.vote_create_note: Each vote gets its own vote token, handed only to members who hold the governance token (the amount follows the "Vote weight" setting above). Only people who hold the governance token can vote. Creating one signs in this order: issuing the token, handing it to members, then registering it on the DAO. With many members, the handing-out is split into groups of 100, so there are more signatures (up to 1000 members). If it stops partway, you can resume.
dao.vote_weight_hint: Weighted: each member gets as many votes as governance tokens held. Unweighted: one vote per member, whatever they hold.
dao.vote_members_only: Only people who hold the governance token can vote.
dao.limited_lead: Only people holding a reward of this DAO can open this page. As a sample, pick a theme colour and save it to your own account.
dao.limited_locked: Only people holding a reward of this DAO (and admins) can open this page.
dao.gov_lead: Proof of DAO membership (not the same thing as points).
dao.gov_note: Whoever holds it is a DAO member, and it sets the weight of their vote. It cannot be transferred. Hand it to new members; take it back to remove one.
dao.gov_send_note: Enter the addresses of the new members (one per line, or comma-separated). Whoever receives it becomes a DAO member.
dao.gov_hint_addresses: Up to {{max}} per operation, sent {{per}} at a time.
dao.row_batches: Sent in {{count}} steps, one after another
dao.row_batches_sss: SSS Extension will ask you to confirm {{count}} times.
dao.cost_cosign_batches: {{count}} of the sends need cosignatures. Each one needs its own cosigning, and each locks its own hash lock.
dao.batch_progress: Sent {{done}} of {{total}}. Please keep this screen open.
dao.batch_stopped: Stopped after {{done}} of {{total}}. What was already sent cannot be undone.
dao.batch_stopped_items: Stopped after {{done}} of {{total}}. The first {{items}} items were already sent. If you try again, leave those out (otherwise they are sent twice).
dao.vote_pending_note: "{{title}}" stopped while its vote tokens were being handed to members. You can continue by sending only to members who have not received one yet. The vote is registered on the DAO last, so it does not show in the list until then. This record is kept in this browser.
dao.err_vote_token_short: You do not have enough vote tokens. Check that you opened the account that created this vote.
dao.ns_lead: Link an easy-to-remember name (e.g. mydao.point) to this mosaic. Once linked, the name is shown instead of the mosaic ID.
dao.ns_current: Currently linked: {{name}} (you can link another name as well)
dao.ns_err_invalid: Invalid name. Use lower-case letters, digits, - and _, up to three levels separated by dots.
dao.ns_state_owned: A namespace the DAO already owns. It will be linked as is.
dao.ns_err_alias: This namespace is already linked to something else.
dao.ns_err_expired: This namespace has expired. Renew it on the Namespace screen first.
dao.ns_state_root: A new namespace. The DAO will rent it and link it right away.
dao.ns_state_child: A new namespace. It will be created under {{parent}} (owned by the DAO) and linked right away.
dao.ns_err_taken: This name is already used by someone else.
dao.ns_err_no_parent: The parent namespace does not exist yet. Create the parent (the part before the last dot) first.
dao.ns_err_parent_other: The parent namespace is not owned by the DAO (or has expired), so nothing can be created under it.
dao.ns_err_fee: Could not load the rental fee. Please try again later.
dao.nsx_lead: The namespaces the DAO account owns, with their expiry dates. A root can be extended with Renew (the DAO signs and the DAO account pays the rental fee; if it is short, the wallet tops it up in the same aggregate).
dao.nsx_none: The DAO does not own any namespace yet.
dao.nsx_renew_lead: The days you enter are added to the current expiry. Existing links stay as they are.
dao.nsx_warn_soon: Namespace {{name}} expires in about {{days}} days. Once it expires, this name no longer points to the mosaic.
dao.nsx_warn_expired: Namespace {{name}} has expired. This name does not point to the mosaic.
dao.err_not_renewable: This namespace cannot be renewed (only roots with an expiry can).
dao.err_invalid_days: The number of days is not valid.
dao.err_fee_unavailable: Could not get the rental fee.
dao.ns_owned_free: Names the DAO owns and has not used yet:
dao.ns_hint_days: {{min}} to {{max}} days. You can renew later.
dao.ns_rental: Rental fee: {{fee}} (topped up to the DAO account in the same transaction if short)

apostille.title: Apostille (notarization)
apostille.explorer_intro: Public apostilles sent to the notarization sink account, newest first. Signed (private) apostilles go to a dedicated account, so they do not appear here.
apostille.explorer_failed: Could not load the list. Check your connection and try again.
apostille.create_intro: Records a fingerprint (hash) of a file on the {{chain}} blockchain to prove "this file existed on this day". The file itself is never sent. The notarized files are saved as a ZIP together with a certificate and a history file.
apostille.type_public_hint: Records the hash only. Anyone holding the file can check it. Sent to the shared apostille account.
apostille.type_signed_hint: Records the hash signed with your key, so it also proves it was you who notarized it. Sent to a dedicated account derived from the file name, and can be updated later.
apostille.update_banner: Updating "{{name}}": the hash of the new file is sent to the same dedicated account.
apostille.fee_hint: A 0 XEM transfer carrying the hash as its message: only the fee is spent.
apostille.fee_hint_symbol: A transfer with no mosaic, carrying the hash as its message: only the fee (XYM) is spent.
apostille.zip_saved: The ZIP was saved. It holds the notarized files (their names include the transaction hash), the certificates and the history file.
apostille.zip_failed: The apostille was recorded, but the ZIP could not be saved. You can export the history file from the History tab.
apostille.keep_note: Keep the saved files exactly as they are, name and content. Changing even one byte makes the audit fail.
apostille.audit_intro: Select a file saved when it was notarized (its name contains "Apostille TX …") to check it against the blockchain record and see whether it was changed. The file never leaves this device.
apostille.audit_empty: Choose files and the results will appear here.
apostille.wrong_format_hint: Select the file under the name it was saved with ("… -- Apostille TX … -- Date ….ext").
apostille.audit_error_hint: Could not reach the node. Check your connection and try again.
apostille.history_intro: Apostilles recorded on this device (per network). You can export them as a history file (.nty) for safekeeping, or import one from NanoWallet.
apostille.import_failed: This could not be read as a history file.
apostille.purge_text: Only this device's history is cleared. The records on the blockchain stay.
apostille.public_only_ledger: A Ledger account can create public apostilles only. A signed (private) one signs the file's hash with your key and derives a dedicated account from it, which a Ledger cannot do because the key never leaves the device.
apostille.public_only_multisig: Only a public apostille can be created in the name of a multisig account. A signed (private) one derives its dedicated account from the signer's own key, which a multisig account does not have.
apostille.multisig_not_eligible: This account cannot sign in the name of the selected multisig account (it is not a cosigner).
apostille.multisig_waiting_note: Other cosigners must sign too ({{count}} signatures including this account). The record is not on the blockchain until they have. The others sign from the multisig screen that lists transactions waiting for a signature.
apostille.multisig_waiting_result: Waiting for the other cosigners. The record goes on the blockchain once the signatures are complete.
apostille.multisig_lock_note: To wait for signatures, {{amount}} is put up as a hash lock (it comes back when the transaction is confirmed). It is not part of the fee above.
apostille.update_not_available: Only a signed apostille can be updated. It cannot be done from a Ledger or a multisig account.

invoice.hint: A payment-request QR with amount, mosaics and a message. Scanning it with the official Symbol Wallet or similar opens the transfer form filled in with these.
invoice.duplicate_mosaic: The same mosaic is listed more than once
invoice.deadline_note: The request is valid for 2 hours from now. Whoever scans it pays the fee and signs.
invoice.qr_too_large: Too much content for a QR. Shorten the message.
invoice.mosaic_lookup_failed: Could not check the mosaic. Check your connection and retype the ID
invoice.nem_hint: An invoice QR with amount, mosaics and a message. Scanning it opens the transfer form filled in with these: with a NEM wallet (NanoWallet etc.) when it is XEM only, or with KASANE when it carries mosaics.
invoice.nem_note: A NEM invoice QR has no deadline. Whoever scans it pays the fee and signs.
invoice.nem_mosaic_note: An invoice QR with a mosaic besides XEM uses the mosaic type (type 4) of the NEM QR draft. Wallets that do not support it, such as NanoWallet, may not read it. KASANE does.
invoice.qr_placeholder: Enter an amount and the invoice QR appears here

settings.live_sound_theme_hint: The sounds for a started and a confirmed transaction both follow the type you pick. Turn sounds on or off with "Alert sound".

logout_confirm_message: Do you want to log out?

settings.custom_theme_import_done_partial: Imported {{count}} theme(s) ({{skipped}} could not be imported because of the theme count or image size limit, or unreadable values).
settings.custom_theme_import_error_too_large: The file is too large to import.

settings.custom_theme_import_error_not_backup: This is not a KASANE custom theme backup.

embedded.title: Opened in a built-in browser
embedded.lead: Please do not use this wallet inside the built-in browser of an AI coding tool (Codex, Claude Desktop, VS Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and the like), or in a browser that an AI is operating.
reasons: Built-in browsers have extra features for AI agents, so they can be weaker than your everyday browser. Problems that let a page read local files have been reported (October 2026).
An AI may be able to read the mnemonic shown on screen and the passwords you type.
If you open an AI-provided link or an HTML file from a project in the same built-in browser, it may be able to reach this wallet's saved data.
embedded.file_note: This wallet is opened as a file (file://). Depending on the browser, it shares its storage with other local HTML files opened in the same browser. Do not open untrusted HTML in that browser.
embedded.address_title: Open it in your usual browser
embedded.address_body: Open Chrome, Edge, Safari or similar yourself and paste this address.
embedded.ack: I understand the risk and want to continue in this built-in browser

Without a backup, they can't be restored.
Are you sure you want to delete this profile?
safe_points: Make several copies offline and store the backups in several places. Use an encrypted disk for digital backups.
Never share your mnemonic with anyone.
Beware of phishing! This app never asks you to enter your mnemonic, except when restoring a profile.
You can back up your mnemonic again from the profile selection screen.
Do not open this app in the built-in browser of an AI coding tool. Never paste your mnemonic, private key or keystore file into an AI chat, and never keep them in a folder an AI tool has open.

Your private key is what controls the associated funds and assets, and is needed to restore your account - this is knowledge everyone needs to have.

disclaimer_points: KASANE Wallet is a non-custodial wallet. Your private keys, recovery phrase and password are kept only on your own device. The developers and operators never hold them, and cannot reissue, recover or reverse anything for you.

The developers and operators accept no responsibility if funds or other assets are stolen or lost - for example through a lost or leaked private key, recovery phrase, password or keystore file, malware on your device, phishing or scams, operation mistakes (wrong recipient, amount or network), node or network failures or bugs, or the specification or defects of the blockchain itself.
Transactions on a blockchain cannot be cancelled or refunded once they are sent. Always check the details before you send.
This wallet is provided "as is", with no warranty of fitness for a particular purpose, accuracy, or uninterrupted or error-free operation. You use it entirely at your own risk.
You are responsible for making your own backups and keeping them safe.

wallet.official_import_intro: Reads the profile data of Symbol Wallet (browser or desktop version) so you can use it in KASANE. The data is processed on this device only and is never uploaded.

wallet.official_import_howto_title: How to get Symbol Wallet's data
official_import_howto: 1. In the browser tab where Symbol Wallet is open, open the developer tools console (F12).
2. Paste the script below into the console and run it. The data is copied to the clipboard.
3. Come back to this dialog and paste it into the box above.

wallet.official_export_locked: Too many wrong attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
wallet.official_export_no_accounts: There are no accounts to export.

wallet.official_export_unsupported_network: Export for Symbol Wallet is not available on mijin v2 (switch to mainnet / testnet).

namespace.renew_none: You have no root namespace that can be renewed.
namespace.renew_days_hint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} days, calculated at 2,880 blocks per day.
namespace.renew_invalid_days: Enter a whole number of days.
namespace.renew_over_max: The rental can be at most {{limit}} days counting what is left. You can add up to {{max}} more days.
namespace.renew_maxed: The remaining period is already close to the limit, so it cannot be extended now.
namespace.renew_expired_warning: It has expired. Past the grace period it may no longer be renewable, or someone else may have registered it.
renew_done_message: Your namespace renewal has been sent.
The expiry will move once the network confirms it.
namespace.renew_alert_message: The namespace {{name}} expires in about {{days}} days.
error_duration_message: The rental period is outside the allowed range.
It can be at most 1,825 days (about 5 years) counting what is left. Please try fewer days.
error_taken_message: This namespace is already registered by another account.
After the grace period you are no longer its owner.
namespace.empty: You haven't registered any namespaces yet
namespace.no_parent: You have no parent to put a sub-namespace under. Register a root namespace first.
namespace.name_hint: Lower-case letters, digits, _ and - (up to 64 characters, starting with a letter or digit).
namespace.days_hint: Between {{min}} and {{max}} days, calculated at 2,880 blocks per day.

namespace.cost_hint: The rental fee is paid to the network at registration and is not refunded.
namespace.xym_short_warning: Your XYM balance may not cover the total cost.
namespace.caution_taken: A name someone else already uses can't be registered. Registering a root you own under the same name extends its period.

error_wrong_network_message: The selected network differs from the account's network.
error_unknown_message: An error occurred while registering the namespace.

namespace.alias_none_available: You have no namespace an alias can be set on (expired ones don't count).
namespace.alias_unlink_hint: Once unlinked, this namespace name can no longer be used to refer to the address / mosaic.
namespace.alias_address_hint: An address alias can only point at this account's own address.
namespace.alias_mosaic_hint: Mosaics you created that have not expired.
namespace.alias_no_mosaic: There is no mosaic to link. Only mosaics you created that have not expired qualify.
namespace.alias_confirm_ready_link: Link the alias with these settings?
namespace.alias_confirm_ready_unlink: Unlink the alias with these settings?

alias_error_wrong_network_message: The selected network differs from the account's network.
alias_error_owner_message: The namespace and the address / mosaic have different owners.

namespace.alias_link_free_hint: Your namespaces that are not expired and not linked to anything yet.

harvest.keyless_note_sss: Signing is done in SSS Extension. Confirmation windows for the start, stop and so on appear in the extension; check them and approve.
harvest.keyless_note_ledger: Signing is done on your Ledger. Connect the device, open the Symbol app, check what is shown on its screen and approve.
harvest.keyless_start_note: Starting asks for two signatures: the key links and the delegation request. The throw-away keys (remote and VRF) are not kept on this device (the node holds them; stopping only needs the public keys on the chain).
harvest.balance_short: Harvesting needs at least {{amount}}. With less, the account cannot create blocks even if it is set up.
harvest.start_balance_short: To start harvesting you need at least {{min}} plus enough XYM to pay the start fee of {{fee}} ({{total}} or more in total). The balance is short, so harvesting cannot be started.
harvest.activation_note: It can take up to about 48 hours before harvesting actually starts. You can check whether the node accepted the request in the explorer.
harvest.partial_note: Only some of the links are set. Stop harvesting first, then start it again.
harvest.about: Delegated harvesting lets a node create blocks for you without moving your XYM. Starting links a throw-away remote account, a VRF account and the node to your account, and sends their keys to the node, encrypted. Those keys cannot send funds.
harvest.node_hint: Some nodes do not accept delegated harvesting. If the node does not, nothing is harvested even after setup.
harvest.no_nodes: The node list could not be loaded. Use "Enter public key" to give the node's public key.
harvest.cost_hint: Total fee of the link transaction and the request sent to the node (2 transactions).
harvest.load_failed: Could not load the harvesting status.
start_confirm_message: Harvesting will be delegated to the node you chose.
Enter your password on the next screen to send the links and the request.
The remote and VRF private keys are kept on this device, encrypted with your password (used to resend the request).
To change the node, stop harvesting first and start again.
stop_confirm_message: The links will be removed and harvesting will stop.
Enter your password on the next screen to send the unlink.
done_start_message: The harvesting setup has been sent.
The status updates once the network confirms it.
It can take up to about 48 hours before harvesting starts.
done_stop_message: The status updates once the network confirms it.
error_insufficient_balance_message: The fees exceed your XYM balance.
Add some XYM and try again.
error_already_linked_message: This account already has harvesting links.
Reload the status, stop harvesting, and try again.
error_deadline_message: The transaction deadline could not be set correctly.
Check your device's date and time and try again.
error_wrong_network_message: The selected network does not match the account's network.
harvest.error_unknown_title: Could not send the harvesting setup
harvest.check_balance_min_ok: Balance is at or above the minimum ({{balance}} / minimum {{min}})
harvest.check_balance_min_ng: Balance is below the minimum ({{balance}} / minimum {{min}})
harvest.check_balance_max_ng: Balance is over the limit ({{balance}} / limit {{max}}). An account over the limit cannot harvest.
harvest.check_importance_warn: Importance is 0. You can link the keys, but no blocks can be harvested until importance has been calculated.
harvest.check_reachable_warn: Could not read the node's information (it is unreachable, or cannot be checked from this screen)
harvest.check_reachable_unknown: This node cannot be checked (it does not publish its information, or only a key was given)
harvest.check_network_ng: The node is on a different network
harvest.check_peer_ok: It is a peer node (it can be used for harvesting)
harvest.check_peer_ng: It is not a peer node. An API-only node cannot harvest.
harvest.check_key_ok: The node public key to link matches the node's own public key
harvest.check_key_warn: The node public key to link differs from the key the node reports. Check that it is not another node's key.
harvest.check_synced_ok: The node is up to date with the latest blocks
harvest.check_synced_warn: The node is {{blocks}} blocks behind. A node that has not finished syncing may be slow to start harvesting.
harvest.check_health_warn: The node does not report healthy
harvest.check_delegation_unknown: Whether the node accepts delegated harvesting is a node setting that cannot be read from outside. After starting, it can take a while before the node accepts it.
harvest.stats_importance_none: This account has no importance yet. The network recalculates importance every set number of blocks.
harvest.stats_blocks_note: A block's fee is the total paid by all of its transactions. The harvest reward is the share this account received (a block with no reward record shows "–").
harvest.net_failed: Could not load the network information.
harvest.net_note: Values read from the connected node, refreshed every 30 seconds. Peer nodes is the number of nodes on the whole network (counted by the statistics service, the same value as the explorer's Total count), counting every type (Peer, API, Voting, and combinations such as Peer API, Voting API and API Voting Peer). On mijin v2 it is the number the connected node knows.
harvest.nem_net_note: Values read from the connected NEM node (NIS1), refreshed every 30 seconds. Nodes is the number of nodes this node can reach (NEM makes no Peer / API distinction). NEM fees are fixed, so there are no fee multipliers like on Symbol.
harvest.history_failed: Could not load the harvest history.
harvest.node_url_hint: The node's public key is fetched from it automatically.
harvest.node_url_err_unreachable: Could not reach the node. Check the URL and port (usually 3001 for https). It also fails when the node does not allow browser access, or when an https page connects to an http node.
harvest.node_url_err_wrong_network: This node is not on the network currently selected.
harvest.node_url_err_no_key: Could not get the node's public key.
harvest.keys_intro: You can link, unlink or replace the three keys one by one by giving their public keys: remote (signs the blocks), VRF (used in the draw for who creates a block) and node (the node that harvests for you). Harvesting is active while all three are linked.
harvest.keys_kind_remote_hint: Public key of the harvesting-only account that signs blocks (account key link)
harvest.keys_kind_vrf_hint: Public key of the VRF account used in the draw for who creates a block (VRF key link)
harvest.keys_kind_node_hint: Public key of the node that harvests for you (node key link)
harvest.keys_link_hint: Enter the public key to link (64 hex characters)
harvest.keys_replace_hint: Enter the new public key. The current link is removed and the new one linked in one transaction
harvest.keys_err_own_key: This account's own public key cannot be linked
harvest.keys_err_same_key: This is the key that is linked now
harvest.keys_err_duplicate_key: This public key is already linked as another kind of key
harvest.keys_fee_slow_warning: A transaction below the average fee may not be accepted and can end up expiring
harvest.keys_private_note: This screen only links and unlinks public keys; it never handles private keys. Harvesting does not start until the node has the private keys of the remote and VRF keys (set them up on your own node, or use "Start" on the Delegated harvesting tab, which creates them and sends them to the node).
keys_confirm_message: Enter your password on the next screen to send it.
Harvesting does not happen while the three keys are not all linked.
keys_done_message: It is shown in the status once the network confirms it.
harvest.keys_changed: The links on the chain had changed, so nothing was sent. The status was refreshed; please try again.
harvest.resend_about: If the node did not get the request (it was restarted or lost its data, for example), this sends the remote and VRF private keys again, encrypted for the linked node. No link is changed.
harvest.resend_key_hint: 64 hex characters. Only keys that match the links on the chain can be sent.
harvest.resend_err_invalid_remote: The remote private key must be 64 hex characters.
harvest.resend_err_invalid_vrf: The VRF private key must be 64 hex characters.
harvest.resend_err_same_key: The remote and VRF keys must be different.
harvest.resend_err_remote_mismatch: This private key does not belong to the linked remote key.
harvest.resend_err_vrf_mismatch: This private key does not belong to the linked VRF key.
harvest.resend_stored_hint: The keys saved when harvesting was started are available. Confirming your password is enough to resend.
harvest.resend_manual_title: You can also type other keys and resend with them.
harvest.reveal_note: These keys can only harvest; they cannot send funds. If you write them down, keep them where nobody else can see them.
harvest.reveal_failed: Could not open the saved keys.
harvest.resend_note: When harvesting is started, the remote and VRF private keys are kept on this device, encrypted with your password. With kept keys you can resend as they are. If none are kept (started earlier, for example), type the keys you wrote down. Without them, stop harvesting and start again (new keys are created).
resend_confirm_message: The remote and VRF private keys are sent, encrypted for the node's public key.
Enter your password on the next screen to send it.
resend_done_message: The delegation request has been sent.
The node receives it once the network confirms it.
It can take up to about 48 hours before harvesting starts.
error_resend_keys_message: The kept or typed private keys do not match the links on the chain.
Check that the links have not changed, then enter the keys again.
harvest.voting_hint: Link or unlink the BLS public key used for finalization voting, together with the range of epochs it is valid for.
harvest.voting_key_hint: Public key of the voting key to link (96 hex characters), shown when the node's voting key file was created
harvest.voting_start_hint: The finalized epoch now is {{current}}. Enter a later number
harvest.voting_start_hint_unknown: The first finalization epoch the link is valid for
harvest.voting_end_hint: The range from start to end must be {{min}} to {{max}} epochs long
harvest.voting_err_invalid_key: Enter 96 hex characters (a 64-character account public key is not a voting key)
harvest.voting_err_already_linked: This voting key and range are already linked
harvest.voting_err_invalid_epoch: Enter an epoch as a whole number of 1 or more
harvest.voting_err_range_reversed: The end epoch must not be before the start epoch
harvest.voting_err_lifetime_short: The range is too short. Make it at least {{min}} epochs
harvest.voting_err_lifetime_long: The range is too long. Make it at most {{max}} epochs
harvest.voting_err_overlap: The range overlaps a voting key that is already linked
harvest.voting_err_too_many: At most {{max}} voting keys can be linked. Unlink one you no longer need
harvest.voting_note: This screen only links and unlinks voting public keys; it never handles private keys (set them up on the node). An unlink uses the linked public key and range exactly as they are on the chain.
voting_confirm_message: Enter your password on the next screen to send it.
Finalization voting does not happen until the node has the voting key's private key.
voting_done_message: The voting key link (unlink) was sent.
It shows in the list once the network confirms it.

account.name: Name
delete_message: This removes the account from this profile.
All data kept on this device for this account (its private key and its settings) is erased completely.
Without a backup of its private key, it can never be used again.
account.metadata_hint: Records a key and value on this account itself. Sending costs a transaction fee.
metadata_sent_message: The metadata transaction has been sent.

account.delete_failed: This account could not be deleted. The default account cannot be deleted. Make another account the default, then try again.
account.unpublished: Not published (not registered on the network)
account.unpublished_hint: The public key is registered on the network after the account sends its first transaction.
account.restriction_hint: Limit on the blockchain which addresses this account can exchange with, which mosaics it can receive and which transaction types it can send.

metadata.draft_error_value_too_long: The value is too long (max 1,024 bytes)

metadata.no_mosaic: There is no mosaic to attach to. Only mosaics you created are eligible.
metadata.no_namespace: There is no namespace to attach to. Only registered, unexpired namespaces are eligible.

metadata.will_overwrite: This key already has a value. Sending will overwrite it.

metadata.other_error_own_address: That is your own address. Choose "Mine" instead

metadata.other_error_invalid_signer: The network doesn't know this account's public key yet. Only an account that has signed a transaction at least once can co-sign.
metadata.other_error_lookup_failed: Couldn't look up the account. Check your connection and try again
metadata.no_mosaic_other: This account has not created any mosaics.

metadata.others_empty: No metadata has been set by others

metadata.others_caution: This metadata was attached by third parties and its content is not verified. Check who set it before trusting any link or instruction in it.
metadata.others_hint: Display only. Entries set by others cannot be changed or removed from here.
metadata.others_truncated: There are many entries, so only the first ones are shown.

multisig.title: Multisig
multisig.intro: Create a jointly managed account that needs several approvals, or cosign for one.
multisig.is_multisig_note: This account is multisig and cannot send on its own. Switch to a cosigner's wallet to send or change settings.
multisig.min_removal_label: Signatures needed to remove a cosigner
multisig.cosigning_none: This wallet does not cosign for any multisig account
multisig.pending_none: No transactions are waiting for signatures
multisig.pending_hint: They stay here until enough cosigners have approved.
multisig.load_failed: Could not load the information (cannot reach the node)
multisig.cosign_sss_unsupported: This transaction contains a type that cannot be cosigned with an SSS Extension profile yet. Cosign it from a profile that opens with a private key.
multisig.cosign_sss_unverified: The content received from the node could not be rebuilt into the data to sign (the hash does not match). Nothing was signed, to be safe. Try again later, or cosign from a profile that opens with a private key.
multisig.cosign_done: Cosignature sent. Wait a moment, then reload.
convert_warning: Once multisig, this account can no longer send on its own.
If you lose the cosigners' keys you cannot move the funds. Back up every cosigner wallet.
Every new cosigner must sign later. Nothing changes until the signatures are in.
multisig.edit_note: A change takes effect only after enough cosigners have signed. Cosigners being added must sign too.
multisig.err_address_network: This address belongs to another network
multisig.err_address_self: The account itself cannot be its own cosigner
multisig.err_no_public_key: The account's public key is not known on the network
multisig.err_not_cosigner: This wallet is not a cosigner of the account
multisig.bonded_hint: Signatures are needed, so a hash lock ({{amount}}) is paid first and the transaction is sent to wait for them. If the signatures do not arrive within the lock period (about 41 hours) the locked amount is lost.
multisig.complete_hint: One approval is enough for this account, so it is sent without waiting for signatures.
multisig.xym_short_warning: Your XYM balance may not be enough.
confirm_dialog_message: Once your password is verified, the transaction is sent.
Review the details carefully before proceeding.
multisig.sending: Sending… waiting for the lock may take 1-2 minutes
done_bonded: It runs once the cosigners sign on the Multisig screen.
done_complete: Please wait for the network to confirm.
multisig.send_note: The funds come from the selected multisig account. This wallet pays the fees and the lock.
multisig.no_account: This wallet does not cosign for any multisig account
error_insufficient_balance_message: Not enough XYM to send.
Check your balance including the lock and fees.
error_deadline_message: Your device clock may be off.
Fix the time and try again.
error_wrong_network_message: The network setting and the destination do not match.

aggregate.csv_heading: Send in bulk from a CSV file
aggregate.csv_intro: Download the sample CSV, fill in the recipients and amounts, and upload it. The transfers are then added to “Contents” below. One aggregate holds up to 100 transactions. If even one row has a mistake, nothing is added.
aggregate.csv_step1_hint: Every recipient in the sample is your own address
aggregate.csv_step2_text: Open it in Excel, Google Sheets or a text editor, change the recipients and amounts, and save it as “CSV UTF-8 (comma delimited)”.
aggregate.csv_check_restrictions: Check the recipients' account restrictions (finds recipients that would refuse the transfer)
csv_format: Column 1 label: a note for yourself (never sent)
Column 2 address: an address, a namespace (e.g. nem.group) or a public key
Column 3 amount: the amount (e.g. 1.5). Leave it empty to send only a message
Column 4 mosaic_id: the mosaic id (16 characters). Empty means XYM
Column 5 message: the message (optional, up to 1023 bytes)
Columns 3 to 5 may be left empty. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Put a message that contains a comma inside "…".
csv_sample_comments: KASANE Wallet aggregate bulk send: sample file. Lines starting with # are ignored.
Columns: label=note (never sent) / address=address, namespace or public key / amount / mosaic_id (empty=XYM) / message
Every recipient in this sample is your own address. Change them before you upload the file (up to 100 rows).

nemharvest.step2_about: This gives the remote account's private key to the node you choose, so that the node harvests for you. This key cannot send funds.

nemonster.title: NEMonster
nemonster.about: NEMonster is a small collecting game on the NEM blockchain. When you catch a monster, a transaction of 0 XEM to your own dedicated address is sent, and the hash of that transaction decides how the new monster looks and what it is called. It works exactly like the official NEM Nano Wallet, so the same account shows the same collection in both.
nemonster.about_symbol: NEMonster is a small collecting game that began on the NEM blockchain, and KASANE lets you play it on Symbol too. When you catch a monster, a transfer with no mosaic (0 XYM) is sent to your own dedicated address, and the hash of that transaction decides how the new monster looks and what it is called. Symbol has no official NEMonster, so this is KASANE's own version; it is separate from your NEM collection.
nemonster.catch_about: The amount sent is 0 XEM; only the fee is charged. Every catch adds one new monster (it appears once the transaction is in a block, about a minute).
nemonster.catch_about_symbol: The amount sent is 0 XYM (a transfer with no mosaic); only the fee is charged. Every catch adds one new monster (it appears once the transaction is in a block, within about a minute).
nemonster.pending: Being caught: {{count}} (they join you once they are in a block)

confirm_message_symbol: A transfer of 0 XYM (no mosaic) is sent to your own dedicated address (fee {{fee}}).
It is sent after you enter your password on the next screen.
A new monster joins you once the transaction is in a block.

A new monster is added to your collection once it is in a block (about a minute).

nemvoting.simple_note: A simple poll is a KASANE-only counting method. The official NEM Wallet does not support it, so it cannot show or count this poll. Also, anyone can create any number of accounts, so one person voting from several accounts cannot be prevented.
nemvoting.mosaic_note: A mosaic-weighted poll is a KASANE-only counting method. The official NEM Wallet does not support it, so it cannot show or count this poll. Holdings are read when the votes are counted, not when they were cast: if mosaics are moved after voting to another account that has also voted, the same mosaics can be counted twice.
nemvoting.holder_note: A mosaic-holder poll is a KASANE-only counting method. The official NEM Wallet does not support it, so it cannot show or count this poll. Whether an account holds the mosaic is decided as of the end of the poll.
