signqr.intro_lead: Read a QR code (or its text) that you received.
signqr.intro_safe: Nothing is signed or sent until you review it and press the button.
signqr.kind_signed_desc: Signed on another device. You review it, then send it.
signqr.kind_cosign_desc: A multisig cosignature that you are asked for, or one that is already done.
signqr.kind_template_desc: Loads the outline of a transfer.
signqr.kind_address_desc: Once read, it is filled into Send on the Home screen.
signqr.intro_adv_title: Data made with symbol-cli, an SDK or the REST API
signqr.intro_adv_body: The payload (hex) of a signed transaction, JSON that holds it and a cosignature body (parentHash / signature / signerPublicKey) can be pasted or loaded from a file as they are. A transaction that needs cosignatures (bonded) is treated as a cosign request.
signqr.invalid: This QR code cannot be read. Only KASANE signing QR codes (signed transaction / cosign request / cosignature / template) are supported. Read address and invoice QR codes on the send screen.
signqr.wrong_network: This QR code is for another network. You are on {{network}}.
signqr.use_signqr_screen: This is a signing QR code. Read it with "Import QR code" in Settings (or "Offline transactions" at the top right of the profile selection screen).
signqr.qr_too_long: The content is too long for a QR code. Copy the text and hand it over (it can be pasted into "Paste the QR text" on the reading side).
signqr.export_button: Sign and make a QR code (do not send)
signqr.export_hint: This is the signed transfer. It has not been sent. Whoever receives this QR code can read it in "Signing QR codes", review it and send it.
signqr.export_note: It expires at {{time}} and cannot be used after that. Anyone holding the QR code can send it, so be careful who you give it to.
signqr.cosign_qr_hint: A cosigner reads this QR code in "Signing QR codes", reviews the transaction and cosigns it. The QR holds the transaction hash (and the data itself when it fits).
signqr.template_hint: Turns the multisig account, recipient, mosaic, amount and message you entered into a QR code that another cosigner can start from. It holds no signature: whoever reads it reviews it and signs and sends it themselves.
signqr.template_account_missing: The account this template sends from is not a multisig account this wallet cosigns for.
signqr.template_read_note: Fills the multisig send screen with the sender, recipient, amount and message. Nothing is signed or sent until you review it there and enter your password.
signqr.template_open_button: Open in the multisig send screen
signqr.template_multiple: A template with several mosaics cannot be opened (a multisig transfer carries one mosaic).
signqr.expired: It has expired. It cannot be sent or cosigned.
signqr.problem_hash_mismatch: The hash in the QR code does not match the data. It may have been tampered with or misread.
signqr.problem_wrong_network: This transaction belongs to another network.
signqr.problem_not_signed: It carries no signature, so it is not a signed-transaction QR code.
signqr.problem_bonded_unsupported: A transaction that needs cosignatures (bonded) cannot be sent from here. Treat it as a cosign request.
signqr.problem_invalid_payload: The transaction data cannot be read.
signqr.problem_not_bonded: This is not a transaction that needs cosignatures (bonded).
signqr.problem_not_found: The node cannot find this transaction. It may already be confirmed, expired, or on another node.
signqr.signed_note: Review it before sending. Sending cannot be undone: it runs from the signer's account exactly as shown.
signqr.sent: Sent. Wait a little for it to be confirmed.
signqr.cosign_note: Review it and cosign if it is fine. Cosigning means you approve this transaction.
signqr.cosign_done: Cosigned. Hand over the cosignature QR or send it to the node.
signqr.send_cosignature: Send the cosignature to the node
signqr.cosignature_sent: The cosignature was sent to the node.
signqr.cosignature_qr_hint: The person who started the transaction reads this QR code in "Signing QR codes" and can send the cosignature to the node.
signqr.cosignature_note: This is a cosigner's signature. If it looks right, send it to the node to add it to the transaction.
signqr.target_unknown: The node you are connected to does not show the target transaction. If it is still waiting for signatures, sending this adds the cosignature.
signqr.image_not_found: No QR code could be read from this image. Choose an image that shows the whole QR code clearly.
signqr.download_failed: Could not save the QR image.
signqr.problem_contents_mismatch: The contents of the transaction do not match the hash that would be signed. It may have been tampered with, so it cannot be cosigned.
signqr.nem_message_encrypted: (encrypted message; only the recipient can read it)
signqr.nem_message_unreadable: (a message that is not readable as text)
signqr.problem_nem_unsupported_type: Only NEM transfers can be sent from here.

watch.invalid: Not a valid Symbol or NEM address

offline_cosign.intro: Load a cosign request that carries the transaction itself ("Show cosign QR" on the starter's screen) by scanning, from an image, from a JSON file or by pasting. Send the cosignature QR or JSON in the "Read and send" tab on a device that is online.
offline_cosign.not_request: This is not a cosign request. Load the QR or JSON of a cosign request.
offline_cosign.hash_only: This QR holds only the hash, not the transaction, so its contents cannot be checked and it is not cosigned offline. Ask the starter for a JSON file that includes the transaction.
offline_cosign.unknown_mosaic_note: Apart from the network currency, only mosaics this device remembers are shown with a name and decimals. Any other mosaic is shown by its id and the amount in the smallest unit (no decimal point).
offline_cosign.clock_warning: Whether it has expired is judged by this device's clock. If the clock is wrong this may be misjudged. Check the date and time before cosigning.
offline_cosign.cosigner_hint: Offline, it cannot be checked that this account really is a cosigner. If it is not, the cosignature is ignored.
offline_cosign.done_note: Cosigned. It has not been sent yet. Carry the QR code or the JSON to a device that is online and send it in the "Read and send" tab.
offline_cosign.qr_hint: On a device that is online, read or paste it in the "Read and send" tab to send it.
offline_cosign.nem_intro: Load the multisig transaction the initiator signed (the signed data, which holds the transaction itself) from a QR code, an image, a JSON file or pasted text. Send the cosignature QR or JSON from the 「Read and send」 tab on a device that is online.
offline_cosign.nem_not_request: This is not a multisig transaction. To cosign, you need the transaction a cosignatory signed in the name of the multisig account (the signed data).
offline_cosign.nem_cosign_note: By cosigning you agree to this transaction. Check it carefully. What is shown is read from the signed data itself.
offline_cosign.nem_other_note: The details of this kind of transaction cannot be shown here. You would cosign knowing only its kind, the multisig account, who started it and its deadline. Do not cosign anything you do not recognize.
offline_cosign.nem_done_note: Cosigned. It has not been sent yet. On NEM a cosignature is only accepted once the initiator's transaction has reached the network: send the initiator's transaction first from the 「Read and send」 tab, then this cosignature.
offline_cosign.nem_label_inner_hash: Hash the cosignature names (the wrapped transaction)
offline_cosign.nem_ms_multisig: Send in the name of a multisig account
offline_cosign.nem_ms_sender: Cosigner who starts it (the account that signs)
offline_cosign.nem_ms_key_hint: Offline, the public key cannot be looked up from an address. Enter the public key (64 hex characters). Whether this account is really multisig, or the chosen account is a cosigner of it, cannot be checked here.
offline_cosign.nem_ms_key_invalid: Enter the public key as 64 hex characters
offline_cosign.nem_ms_key_self: The public key of the cosigner who starts it cannot be used
offline_cosign.nem_ms_note: This makes a request for the other cosignatories, in the name of the multisig account. Only the cosigner who starts it signs; nobody has signed the transfer inside yet. It runs once enough cosignatures have been collected.
offline_cosign.nem_ms_inner_fee: Fee paid by the multisig account
offline_cosign.nem_ms_wrapper_fee: Fee paid by the cosigner who starts it
offline_cosign.nem_ms_validity_fixed: It is valid for 2 hours from signing (this cannot be changed for a multisig transaction).
offline_cosign.nem_ms_done_note: The request is made. It has not been sent yet. First send this QR or JSON from the 「Read and send」 tab on a device that is online. Then the other cosignatories cosign it in 「Cosign a transaction」, and send their cosignatures from 「Read and send」 too.
offline_cosign.sym_ms_note: This makes a request for the other cosignatories, in the name of the multisig account. Only the cosigner who starts it signs; nobody has signed the transfer inside yet. It runs once enough cosignatures have been collected. The cosigner who starts it has to put 10 XYM down as a hash lock (it is returned once the transfer runs).
offline_cosign.sym_ms_lock_deposit: Hash lock deposit (returned once the transfer runs)
offline_cosign.sym_ms_validity_note: Send the hash lock within the time chosen above. The request can collect cosignatures for 40 hours from signing.
offline_cosign.sym_ms_done_note: The request (a hash lock and the transfer waiting for cosignatures) is made. It has not been sent yet. Send this QR or JSON from the 「Read and send」 tab on a device that is online. The request is sent once the hash lock is confirmed. Then the other cosignatories cosign it in 「Cosign a transaction」, and send their cosignatures from 「Read and send」 too.

offline_tx.wrong_chain: This QR code is for {{qr}}. Choose "{{qr}} …" above (you have {{selected}} selected).
offline_tx.import_lead: Reads a transaction made offline (QR code, JSON or file) and issues it to the network. Reading alone sends nothing: it is sent only when you check it and press Send.
offline_tx.reader_offline: This device is offline. Connect to the network, then send.
offline_tx.issued_notice: Not sent because this device is offline: a QR code of the signed transaction was created.
offline_tx.reason_offline: This device is offline, so the transaction was not sent. It is already signed: read the QR code below (or the file / text) on a device that is online and it can be issued as it is.
offline_tx.reason_unreachable: No node could be reached, so the transaction was not sent. It is already signed: read the QR code below (or the file / text) on a device that is online and it can be issued as it is.
offline_tx.role_lock: Hash lock (deposit for waiting for cosignatures)
offline_tx.deadline_warning: It is valid until {{time}}. After that it can no longer be issued. The deadline was set from this device's clock, so check that the clock is correct.
offline_tx.qr_note: This QR code holds only the signed transaction, not a private key. Closing this screen discards the QR code.
offline_tx.step1: Open KASANE Wallet on a device that is online (this device will do once it is back online).
offline_tx.step2: On the profile selection screen open "Offline transaction", then choose "Read and send".
offline_tx.step3: Read this QR code (or the file / text), check the contents and press Send.
offline_tx.send_now: Read it on this device now
offline_tx.bundle_note: {{count}} transactions are issued in this order. A hash lock is awaited until it is confirmed before the next one goes out.
offline_tx.nem_bundle_note: {{count}} transactions are issued in this order.
offline_tx.problem_bundle_structure: The order of the transactions is not valid (a hash lock must be followed by its aggregate).
offline_tx.nem_other_note: The details of this kind of transaction cannot be shown here. It was signed on the device that made it (the signature is checked), and sending it cannot let anyone else move your assets.

offline_ui.lead: Sign on a PC that is not connected to the network and carry the result out as a QR code or JSON. This page never contacts a node.

offline_ui.import_file: Load from a file (QR image / JSON)
offline_ui.import_payload_note: You can also enter the payload of a transaction made with symbol-cli or similar.
offline_ui.send_desc: Read the signed QR code or JSON on a device that is online and send it. If this device is online, you can do it right here (no key is needed).

restriction.title: Account restrictions
restriction.intro: Limit which addresses this account can deal with, which mosaics it can receive and which kinds of transaction it can send. The settings are stored on the blockchain. Use either an allow list (only what is listed is permitted) or a block list (what is listed is refused).
restriction.watch_only: This is a view-only profile, so you can only see the current settings. Open an account that has its private key to change them.
restriction.load_failed: Could not load the restrictions (cannot reach the node)
restriction.mode_locked_hint: This list already has values, so its mode cannot be changed. To change the mode, remove everything from the list first.
restriction.explain_address_incoming_allow: Only incoming transfers from the listed addresses are accepted. Transfers from any other address fail.
restriction.explain_address_incoming_block: Incoming transfers from the listed addresses are refused.
restriction.explain_address_outgoing_allow: You can only send to the listed addresses. Transfers to any other address fail.
restriction.explain_address_outgoing_block: You cannot send to the listed addresses.
restriction.explain_mosaic_incoming_allow: Only the listed mosaics can be received. Receiving any other mosaic fails.
restriction.explain_mosaic_incoming_block: The listed mosaics cannot be received.
restriction.explain_operation_outgoing_allow: Only the listed kinds of transaction can be sent from this account.
restriction.explain_operation_outgoing_block: The listed kinds of transaction cannot be sent from this account.
restriction.address_hint: A Symbol address starting with N… / T… (hyphens are fine), or a namespace name such as nem.group. A namespace is replaced by the address it is linked to right now.
restriction.pick_held_mosaic: Pick from the mosaics you hold
restriction.input_error_own_address: You cannot use your own address
restriction.input_error_wrong_network: This address is not on the selected network
restriction.input_error_invalid_mosaic_id: Enter the mosaic ID as 16 hex digits
restriction.problem_too_many_values: This is more than one list can hold (512).
restriction.problem_too_many_changes: You can add or remove at most 255 values at a time.
restriction.problem_operation_lockout: An allow list of operations must include "Account operation restriction". Without it you could never change the restrictions again.
restriction.caution_allow_address: With an allow list, you cannot deal with any address that is not on it. Check that everyone you need is listed.
restriction.caution_allow_mosaic: Mosaics that are not on the allow list (XYM included) can no longer be received. Check that every mosaic you want to receive is listed.
restriction.caution_allow_operation: Kinds of transaction that are not on the allow list can no longer be sent from this account.
restriction.fee_hint: Setting a restriction costs only the transaction fee.
restriction.xym_short_warning: Your XYM balance may not cover the fee.
confirm_dialog_message: Confirming your password sends the account restriction.
A wrong allow list can stop you from sending or receiving. Please review the details carefully.
done_message: The account restriction has been sent.
It takes effect once the network confirms it.
error_insufficient_balance_message: The fee is more than your XYM balance.
Add some XYM and try again.
error_deadline_message: The transaction deadline could not be set correctly.
Check your device date and time, then try again.
error_wrong_network_message: The selected network differs from the account's network.
error_redundant_message: You tried to add a value that is already on the list, or to remove one that is not.
Reopen the screen and check the current setting.
error_own_address_message: Your own address cannot be put on a restriction list.
error_too_many_message: The list, or this single change, would exceed the allowed number of values.
Reduce the number and try again.
error_conflict_message: It does not fit the list's current mode (allow / block), or it is a combination that cannot be set.
To change the mode, remove everything from the list first.
Details: {{detail}}
error_unknown_message: An error occurred while setting the restriction.
restriction.multisig_note: You change a multisig account's restrictions as a cosigner. This wallet signs and sends the aggregate and pays the fee (and the lock amount when signatures are still needed) from its own XYM. When two or more approvals are required, nothing takes effect until the other cosigners have signed.
confirm_dialog_message_multisig_complete: When you confirm your password, the multisig account's restriction is sent.
A wrong allow list can stop this multisig account from sending funds or from being reconfigured. Check the details carefully.
confirm_dialog_message_multisig_bonded: When you confirm your password, the hash lock ({{amount}}) is paid first and the restriction change is sent to wait for signatures.
It takes effect once the other cosigners sign. If the signatures are not complete within the lock period (about 41 hours), the locked amount is not returned.
A wrong allow list can stop this multisig account from sending funds or from being reconfigured. Check the details carefully.
done_multisig_complete: The multisig account's restriction has been sent.
It takes effect once the network confirms it.
done_multisig_bonded: It takes effect once the other cosigners sign on the multisig screen.
error_prohibited_message: This account is a multisig account and cannot act alone.
Choose the multisig account from a cosigner wallet and operate from there.
error_lock_timeout_message: The hash lock was not confirmed in time.
Please check the transaction history or the explorer after a while.
error_blocked_by_restriction_message: An account restriction on this wallet or on the multisig account does not allow this transaction.
Check that the operation allow list includes aggregates and account restriction changes.

console.title: Console
console.intro: Type code one piece at a time and run transfers, mosaic creation and more with this wallet's account. Network: {{network}}
console.safety: Do not paste code that someone else gave you or that you found online. Only run code you have read and understand. Code can request signatures, receive decrypted contents, and send data to the internet. Every signature, encryption and decryption asks you to review it and enter your password first, and your private key is never handed to the code, but whatever you approve in a confirmation dialog can be used by malicious code.
console.no_account: There is no account with a key
console.account_unusable: The account selected in the wallet ({{active}}) has no key here (view-only, Ledger, SSS …), so the console cannot use it. {{signer}} is used as wallet instead.
console.lang_hint_js: Runs the code as JavaScript, as is.
console.lang_hint_ts: Strips the types, then runs the code (types are not checked, so a type mismatch is not an error). Samples are inserted with types, too.
console.file_loaded: Loaded “{{name}}” ({{lines}} lines, {{lang}}). Check the code, then press “Run”.
console.file_lang_switched: Switched the language to {{lang}} to match the file.
console.file_err_too_big: “{{name}}” is too large ({{size}} KB; the limit is {{max}} KB).
console.file_err_binary: “{{name}}” does not look like a text file (it contains binary data).
console.file_err_dts: “{{name}}” is a type declaration file (.d.ts); it has no code to run.
console.file_err_jsx: “{{name}}” is JSX / TSX. The console does not support JSX; please use plain .js / .ts.
console.file_warn_encoding: “{{name}}” may not be UTF-8 (it contains characters that could not be read). Please save it as UTF-8.
console.save_empty: There is no code to save.
console.hint_node: Hint: Node.js features such as require / module / process are not available. Use an import statement (e.g. import { SymbolFacade } from 'symbol-sdk/symbol') or the variables provided here (facade, alice, NODE …).
console.help_file_open: Open file … loads a .js / .mjs / .cjs / .ts / .mts / .cts / .txt file (UTF-8, up to 512 KB) into the input box. It is never run automatically: read it, then press “Run”. The language switches to match the extension.
console.help_file_save: Save code … downloads the code in the input box (or, when it is empty, the code you ran last) as a .js / .ts file.
console.help_file_error: Errors … a syntax error shows the line, the column and that line of code with a ^ marker. A runtime error shows its type, message and line. For a loaded file, “file name:line:column” is added.
console.file_err_md_none: “{{name}}” has no runnable code blocks (js / javascript / ts / typescript).
console.md_pick_body: “{{name}}” has {{count}} js / ts code blocks. Choose which to load (several are joined in order into one).
console.help_file_md: Obsidian notes (.md) … the ```js and ```ts code blocks are extracted and loaded (~~~ fences and blocks inside > quotes or lists work too). A single block is loaded as is; with several, you choose. Error line numbers match the lines in the note. You can also paste the whole note into the input box (you are asked first; “Paste as is” is available too).
console.paste_body: The pasted text contains {{count}} js / ts code block(s) and looks like a Markdown note. Extract only the code blocks and load them? (“Paste as is” puts the text into the input box unchanged.)
console.shortcut: Enter runs, Shift + Enter adds a line (Enter also adds a line while a bracket is still open). ↑ ↓ recall earlier input, Ctrl + L clears the output. Your input is marked “<”, the results “>”. Variables stay between runs (Reset clears them).
console.output_empty: Your input and the results appear here. Type code at the “<” below and press Enter.
console.help_facade: facade … a SymbolFacade for the current network. SDK classes (PrivateKey, Address, models, generateMosaicId …) are ready to use too.
console.help_node: NODE … the URL of the node you are connected to, e.g. fetch(new URL('/node/info', NODE)).
console.help_wallet: alice … the account the wallet is using (wallet works too). alice.address / alice.publicKey / alice.signTransaction(tx) / alice.messageEncoder() are available (the private key is never handed over; you are asked at every signature, encryption and decryption). walletKeyPair / walletAddress are available too.
console.help_clog: clog(tx) … prints the status and explorer URLs of an announced tx.
console.help_sdk: await import('…symbol-sdk…') and import statements such as import { SymbolFacade } from 'symbol-sdk/symbol' work too (they return the bundled SDK; no outside code is loaded).
console.help_web: fetch / WebSocket / setTimeout are available. By default, requests can only go to hosts on the internet and to the node you are using (this computer, your local network and localhost are blocked, and redirects are not followed). The developer settings let you turn off “Limit network access” and the other protections one by one. Print with console.log. The value of the last expression is shown on a “>” line.
console.help_keep: A key you create yourself (facade.createAccount(sdkCore.PrivateKey.random()) …) signs without a prompt. Handy for trying things on the testnet. Give it a name other than alice / wallet (bob, for example) and the wallet account stays available.
console.help_limit_syntax: You cannot wait for a signature inside a class constructor or a synchronous generator (function*); use an async function or async function* instead. In a callback whose result is used on the spot (such as a sort comparator), waiting returns a Promise instead of a value.
console.help_limit_ts: TypeScript … The switch applies from the next code you run. Type annotations, interface, type, as, !, generics, enum, and constructor parameter modifiers are stripped before running; types are not checked. A namespace that holds values is not supported (it raises an error).
console.help_limit_access: The page (document), stored data (localStorage) and eval. The code only sees what is handed over here.
console.help_limit_size: Code that builds a huge string, array or BigInt in one operation stops with an error. Heavy work that does not respond to Stop, such as a catastrophic regular expression, is force-stopped after a second or two (variables you created are lost when that happens).
console.worker_restarted: The code could not be stopped gently, so the console was restarted (your variables are gone).
console.sample_restrict_global: Global mosaic restriction (create a restrictable mosaic)
console.sample_verify_merkle: Verify a transaction in a block
console.intro_nem: Type NEM (NIS1) code one piece at a time and run transfers, mosaic creation and more with this wallet's account. Network: {{network}}
console.nem_no_node: Cannot reach a NEM node. On the testnet, set an HTTPS node in the settings.
console.help_facade_nem: facade … a NemFacade for the current network. The NEM SDK's classes (PrivateKey, Address, models, descriptors, calculateTransactionFee …) are ready to use too, and sdkNem holds them all.
console.help_node_nem: NODE … the URL of the NIS1 node you are connected to, e.g. fetch(new URL('/node/info', NODE)). Announce with POST /transaction/announce.
console.help_wallet_nem: alice … the account the wallet is using (wallet works too). alice.address / alice.publicKey / alice.signTransaction(tx) / alice.messageEncoder() are available (the private key is never handed over; you are asked at every signature, encryption and decryption). NEM has no cosign methods. walletKeyPair / walletAddress are available too.
console.help_clog_nem: clog(tx) … prints URLs to check tx (the node's /transaction/get and the explorer).
console.help_keep_nem: A key you create yourself (facade.createAccount(sdkCore.PrivateKey.random()) …) signs without a prompt. Handy for trying things on the testnet. Give it a name other than alice / wallet (bob, for example) and the wallet account stays available.
console.nem_sign_detail: Contents of the transaction (the bytes to be signed, read back by the SDK)
console.sign_warning: The code running in the console is asking to sign with your account. If you do not recognise this, cancel.
console.sign_data_warning: This signs arbitrary data, not a transaction. Do not sign data you do not understand.
console.sign_data_hash32_warning: This is exactly 32 bytes, the same shape as a transaction hash. Signing it may co-sign someone else's transaction. If you do not recognise it, cancel.
console.sign_via_raw_warning: The code asked for this as "sign arbitrary data", but the bytes are a transaction. Check the details below (recipient, amount, etc.).
console.sign_hash_only_warning: This signs a transaction hash (32 bytes). It cannot be checked here which transaction the hash belongs to. Signing it co-signs that transaction. Cancel unless this is a co-signature for a transaction you prepared yourself.
console.net_limit_hint: When on, fetch / WebSocket in your code cannot reach this computer, your local network or localhost (except the node you are using). Saved in this browser and applied immediately, even to running code.
console.net_unlimited_notice: The network limit is off. Code can reach services on this computer and your local network. Do not run code from other people.
console.net_unlimited_body: With the limit off, console code can reach localhost and devices on your local network (router, NAS, servers you are developing) without you seeing it. Turn it off only when you are running code you wrote or have read and understood.
console.prot_intro: These four are all on (protected) by default. Turn off only the ones that get in the way of your development server. Saved in this browser and applied immediately, even to running code. Schemes other than http / https / ws / wss are also blocked by the browser's CSP, so they cannot be switched here.
console.prot_off_notice: Some network protections are off. Code can send credentials or the referrer. Do not run code from other people.
console.prot_blockUrlCredentials_label: Block user name / password in URLs
console.prot_blockUrlCredentials_hint: When off, URLs such as https://user:pass@host/ are allowed (for example a dev server with Basic auth).
console.prot_blockUrlCredentials_title: Allow user name / password in URLs?
console.prot_blockUrlCredentials_body: With this off, code can send requests to URLs of the form https://user:pass@host/. A password written in a URL can remain in histories, logs and on the server. Turn it off only when you are running code you wrote or have read and understood.
console.prot_omitCookies_hint: When off, fetch follows the credentials option in your code (or the browser default) and can send cookies and other credentials. Cookies on WebSocket are decided by the browser.
console.prot_omitCookies_body: With this off, fetch in your code can send the cookies you have stored for the target site (so it can act as you on services you are logged in to). Turn it off only when you are running code you wrote or have read and understood.
console.prot_hideReferrer_hint: When off, fetch follows the referrerPolicy option in your code (or the browser default), so the URL of this wallet may be sent to the target as the referrer.
console.prot_hideReferrer_title: Allow the referrer to be sent?
console.prot_hideReferrer_body: With this off, requests from your code may tell the target the URL where this wallet is open. Turn it off only when you are running code you wrote or have read and understood.
console.sign_cosign_note: This is a cosignature (approval of an aggregate transaction).
console.sign_unreadable: The transaction could not be read. Do not sign something you cannot read.
console.sign_wrong_network: This transaction is for a different network than the current one.
console.sign_hash_mismatch: The aggregate's contents do not match the hash that would be signed. Do not sign.
console.crypt_warning_encrypt: The code running in the console is asking to encrypt a message with your account's key. Only the ciphertext is handed back to the code, never the private key. If you do not recognise this, cancel.
console.crypt_warning_decrypt: The code running in the console is asking to decrypt a message with your account's key. The decrypted contents are handed to the code, which can also send them to the internet (the private key is not handed over). If you do not recognise this, cancel.

signmsg.about: Signs a text with your account's key. With the signature and the public key, anyone can check that the owner of that public key signed that text. It is not a transaction: nothing is sent to the blockchain and there is no fee.
signmsg.warning: Do not sign strings you do not understand, or text someone else tells you to sign. What you sign is treated as yours.
signmsg.message_hint: Every space and line break is signed too. The same text is needed to verify it.
signmsg.message_too_long: The message is too long (up to {{max}} bytes)
signmsg.signed_note: Signed. Hand the message, the signature and the public key to the other person so they can verify it.
signmsg.share_hint: The message, signature and public key in one text. The other person can paste it into the paste box on the Verify tab.
signmsg.share_nano_hint: The format NanoWallet reads as is: paste it into its "Verify a signed message". The message is the signed bytes in hex.
signmsg.verify_intro: Paste the text of a signed message and press Verify to check that the message, public key and signature match.
signmsg.paste_label: Paste the text of a signed message
signmsg.paste_hint: Text made by KASANE, or a NanoWallet signed message ({"message", "signer", "signature"}). JSON with just {"message", "publicKey", "signature"} also works
signmsg.paste_invalid: It cannot be read. Check that the message, the public key (64 digits) and the signature (128 digits) are all there.
signmsg.public_key_invalid: A public key is 64 hexadecimal digits
signmsg.address_hint: If entered, it is also checked that the public key belongs to this address.
signmsg.valid_note: The owner of this public key (address: {{address}}) signed this message.
signmsg.valid_nano_encoding: Emoji and similar characters matched as signed with NanoWallet's text encoding.
signmsg.invalid_note: The message, the public key or the signature is different, or was changed. Even one space or line break makes it fail.
signmsg.mismatch_title: The signature is valid, but the address is different
signmsg.mismatch_note: The address of this public key is {{address}}. A different account from the one you entered signed it.
signmsg.signed_empty: Sign a message and the signed message will appear here.
signmsg.result_empty: The result will appear here after you verify.
signmsg.manual_toggle: Enter the message, public key and signature separately
signmsg.symbol_signer_none: There is no Symbol account that can sign (Ledger and view-only accounts cannot)
signmsg.paste_hint_symbol: The text made by KASANE. A JSON with just {"message", "publicKey", "signature"} also works
signmsg.paste_is_nem: This is a NEM signed message. NEM and Symbol use different signature schemes, so it cannot be verified here. Switch to NEM from the menu at the top left and verify it there.

nemdns.title: DNS
nemdns.about: Links a website address and contact details to a namespace. From a name like "kasane.nem" you can look up what its owner registered.
nemdns.search_about: Look up the website address and contact details the owner registered for a namespace name (e.g. kasane.nem).
nemdns.search_hint: ".nem" may be added or left out.
nemdns.err_invalid_name: The namespace name is not valid. Use lower-case letters, digits, "_" and "-" only: up to 16 characters for the root, and up to 3 levels in all.
nemdns.err_lookup_failed: The lookup failed. Check the network and try again.
nemdns.expired_note: This namespace has expired. Its owner may have changed, and what is shown may be out of date.
nemdns.no_record: No DNS information is registered for this namespace.
nemdns.record_found: Information registered by the owner was found.
nemdns.record_empty: Nothing is registered in any field.
nemdns.open_site_note: Opens: {{url}} (an address the owner registered; make sure you trust them before opening it)
nemdns.site_not_openable: The website address is not in a form that can be opened.
nemdns.configure_about: Register or update the website address and contact details of your own namespace. It is just a 0 XEM transfer carrying the details to the pointer account; only what the namespace owner sent is shown in searches.
nemdns.public_warning: What you register is recorded on the blockchain and anyone can read it. Do not put personal information (a home address, a phone number...). An update shows the new details, but the old ones stay on record.
nemdns.owner_account_hint: A multisig namespace is registered in the name of that account (cosignatures are needed).
nemdns.no_namespace: There is no namespace you can register. (Expired ones are left out.)
nemdns.result_empty: Search for a namespace and its registered details will appear here.
nemdns.configure_empty: Choose a namespace on the left and the fields for its details will appear here.
nemdns.pointer_hint: This is the namespace's "address". Anyone can work out its key, so do not send XEM or other assets to it.
nemdns.hint_organization: e.g. a company or group name
nemdns.too_long: Too long (up to {{max}} bytes). Please shorten it.
nemdns.fee_multisig_note: Breakdown: transfer fee {{transfer}} (paid by the multisig account) + signing fee {{wrapper}} (paid by this account)
nemdns.send_note: Sends 0 XEM carrying the details to the pointer account. It does not show up in searches until it is confirmed (about a minute).
nemdns.sent_note: Wait until the network confirms it (about a minute); then it shows up in searches.
nemdns.sent_multisig: Sent in the name of a multisig account. It is recorded once enough cosignatures are collected.
nemdns.err_insufficient: The XEM balance is not enough. Check that there is enough to pay the fee.

symbolvoting.type_mosaic_hint: Anyone can vote; votes are weighted by how much of the chosen mosaic each account holds. The calculation is the same as "Importance-weighted".
symbolvoting.counting_mosaic: Votes are weighted by each account's holdings of the chosen mosaic as of the end of the poll. If an account gave some away during the poll, what is left at the end is what counts. A vote from an account that holds none of the mosaic at the end is invalid. Only confirmed votes count.
symbolvoting.approximate_mosaic_note: Holdings at the end of the poll are estimated from the transfer history (changes that do not show as transfers, such as harvesting rewards, are not reflected).
symbolvoting.mosaic_placeholder: Mosaic ID (16 characters) or namespace name
symbolvoting.mosaic_hint: e.g. 6BED913FA20223F8 or symbol.xym. A namespace linked to a mosaic can be used by name.
symbolvoting.mosaic_err_invalid: Enter a 16-digit hex mosaic ID or a namespace name.
symbolvoting.mosaic_err_not_found: This mosaic was not found on the chain.
symbolvoting.mosaic_err_alias: This namespace is not linked to a mosaic.
symbolvoting.mosaic_err_failed: Could not check. Check your connection and try again.
symbolvoting.mosaic_zero_warning: This account holds none of the chosen mosaic. If it still holds none when the poll ends, its vote is invalid.
symbolvoting.simple_note: A simple poll cannot stop one person from voting with several accounts (anyone can create any number of them). Use a whitelist when you need a strict count.
symbolvoting.list_hint: The polls listed in the public index. This index is a dedicated address that only KASANE's Symbol polls are written to.
symbolvoting.create_intro: A poll is written to the blockchain and listed in the index. It can't be changed after it is created. It is sent as one aggregate, so a half-written poll can never appear.
symbolvoting.xym_short_warning: Not enough XYM. You need XYM for the fee.
symbolvoting.cost_hint: A poll is written as one aggregate of 0-XYM transfers with messages; only its fee is charged.
error_insufficient_balance_message: The fee is more than your XYM balance.
Add some XYM and try again.
symbolvoting.provisional_note: This is a provisional result for a poll that is still running. It is settled by the mosaic holdings at the end of the poll.
symbolvoting.excluded_note: Votes invalid because the account holds none of the mosaic at the end: {{count}}
symbolvoting.my_vote_invalid: Your vote is invalid because you hold none of the mosaic (it carries no weight).
symbolvoting.type_holder_hint: Only accounts that hold the chosen mosaic can vote. The amount held does not matter: one account, one vote.
symbolvoting.counting_holder: Only votes from accounts that hold the chosen mosaic as of the end of the poll are counted, one account one vote (the amount held is not a weight). If an account gave all of it away during the poll, its vote is invalid. Only confirmed votes count.
symbolvoting.holder_rule_nt_desc: Only a mosaic that cannot be moved to third parties can be chosen. Only its creator can hand it out, so the number of holders cannot grow on its own.
symbolvoting.holder_rule_any_desc: A mosaic that anyone can pass on can be chosen as well. Use this for a mosaic that is already widely held.
symbolvoting.holder_rule_any_warning: With a transferable mosaic even a tiny amount is enough to vote, so anyone can add votes just by splitting the mosaic up and sending it to other accounts. To prevent duplicate votes, choose "Non-transferable mosaics only".
symbolvoting.holder_nt_required_error: "Non-transferable mosaics only" cannot use a mosaic that is transferable. Choose a non-transferable mosaic, or change the condition to "Transferable mosaics are fine too".
symbolvoting.holder_rule_broken_note: This poll is set to "non-transferable mosaics only", but the chosen mosaic is transferable. The condition is not met, so no vote is counted.
symbolvoting.holder_my_vote_invalid: Your vote is invalid because you hold none of the mosaic at the end of the poll.

symboldns.about: Links a website address and contact details to a namespace. From a name like "kasane" you can look up what its owner registered.
symboldns.search_about: Look up the website address and contact details the owner registered for a namespace name (e.g. kasane).
symboldns.search_hint: Write a sub-namespace with dots, like "company.team".
symboldns.err_invalid_name: The namespace name is not valid. Use lower-case letters, digits, "_" and "-" only: up to 64 characters per name, and up to 3 levels in all.
symboldns.configure_about: Register or update the website address and contact details of your own namespace. It is just a transfer with no mosaic, carrying the details to the pointer account; only what the namespace owner sent is shown in searches.
symboldns.pointer_hint: This is the namespace's "address". Anyone can work out its key, so do not send XYM or other assets to it.
symboldns.send_note: Sends a transfer with no mosaic, carrying the details, to the pointer account (only the fee is spent). It does not show up in searches until it is confirmed (about a minute).
symboldns.err_insufficient: The XYM balance is not enough. Check that there is enough to pay the fee.
